jobs.title: - Vi søker betongarbeidere / We are hiring concrete workers
jobs.description:
Vi søker betongarbeidere til prosjekter over hele Norge

 

Vi søker dyktige betongarbeidere til oppdrag med snarlig oppstart. Arbeidet vil foregå på prosjekter flere steder i landet.

Er dette aktuelt for deg? Send søknad eller ta kontakt på e-post: markus@personellgruppen.no

 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Fagbrev som betongarbeider er en fordel, men lang erfaring kan kompensere for manglende fagbrev
  • Erfaring fra arbeid i Norge er en stor fordel
  • Erfaring med forskaling, armering og støp
  • Evne til å jobbe selvstendig og effektivt
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner og forståelse av norsk og/eller engelsk

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med hyggelige kolleger
  • Oppdrag med gode muligheter for forlengelse
  • Gode betingelser, forsikringer og pensjonsordning
  • Hjelp til å skaffe bolig ved behov

Søk snarest – ansettelser skjer fortløpende.

 

Personellgruppen ansetter kontinuerlig kandidater til flere typer stillinger og prosjekter over hele landet. Dersom du har erfaring fra tekniske fag eller prosjektarbeid, oppfordrer vi deg til å ta kontakt.

 

 

_____________________________

 

We are hiring Concrete Workers for projects across Norway

 

We are looking for skilled concrete workers for projects with immediate start. The work will take place on projects in different locations across Norway.

Interested? Send your application or contact us by email: markus@personellgruppen.no

 

Desired qualifications:

  • Trade certificate as a concrete worker is an advantage, but long experience can compensate for lack of formal certification
  • Experience working in Norway is a strong advantage
  • Experience with formwork, reinforcement, and concrete casting
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently
  • Good communication skills and understanding of Norwegian and/or English

We offer:

  • A good working environment with friendly colleagues
  • Projects with good possibilities for extension
  • Competitive conditions, insurance, and pension scheme
  • Assistance with accommodation if needed

Apply as soon as possible – hiring takes place on an ongoing basis.

 

Personellgruppen continuously recruits candidates for several types of positions and projects across Norway. If you have experience in technical trades or project-based work, we encourage you to get in touch.


 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Personellgruppen AS er et selskap med kjernekompetanse innen formidling og utleie av faglært arbeidskraft. Vi rekrutterer i dag medarbeidere til et bredt utvalg av fagområder. Personellgruppen AS er medlem av NHO og NHO Service

jobs.title: Jeg ønsker snille og omsorgsfulle assistenter i mitt team, som ikke er redd for å by litt på seg selv!
jobs.description:
Hei! 

Jeg ser etter nye assistenter som kan være med på å gjøre hverdagen min enklere! Akkurat nå har jeg behov for å utvide teamet mitt av dyktige, snille tilkallingsassistenter, med mulighet for fast ansettelse på sikt. 

Litt om meg:

Jeg er en positiv, pratsom og sosial 20-åring som har Duchenne muskeldystrofi, noe som gjør at jeg bruker rullestol. Jeg trenger hjelp til å få hverdagen til å fungere. Arbeidsoppgavene kan være alt fra praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet, til å bli med på aktiviteter jeg liker.

Hva jeg liker:

  • Matlaging: Jeg elsker å lage og prøve nye, sunne oppskrifter, så hvis du har matlagingsskills, er det et stort pluss!
  • Turer: Enten det er i skogen (med eller uten hund) eller en kjøretur, setter jeg pris på å komme meg ut.
  • Gaming & hobbyer: Jeg digger å spille på X-box og Nintendo, og jeg kan fort bruke timer på å bygge Lego.
  • Sosialt: Kafébesøk, kino og god samtale står også høyt på lista

Det viktigste for meg er god kjemi og at vi deler noen felles interesser.

Hva jeg ser etter i deg:

  • Du er blid, pålitelig, aktiv og tar initiativ.
  • Du har førerkort klasse B (manuelt gir), snakker flytende norsk og kan fremlegge politiattest.

Arbeidstid og opplæring:

Du vil jobbe langvakter (08.00–20.00 og/eller 20.00–08.00), og grundig opplæring blir selvfølgelig gitt. Vi leter etter deg som kan bidra i teamet både hverdag og helg. 

Hvorfor jobbe hos meg?

Som assistent hos meg blir du en viktig del av livet mitt. Du får muligheten til å bidra til min selvstendighet, samtidig som vi kan skape morsomme, meningsfulle øyeblikk sammen.

Interessert?
Vi vurderer kandidater og kaller inn til intervju fortløpende, så ikke nøl med å søke! Kanskje er det akkurat DU som blir en del av teamet mitt?

Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. jobs.title: Produktionsledare - Kalmar
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Har du erfarenhet av ledarskap i en produktionsmiljö och drivs av att skapa struktur, engagemang och ständiga förbättringar? Hos Epiroc börjar allt med människor – och nu söker vi en engagerad och kommunikativ Produktionsledare som vill vara med och forma framtidens produktion i Kalmar. Vår organisation i sin nuvarande form är relativt ny, vilket ger dig stora möjligheter att påverka, utveckla och sätta struktur i verksamheten.

Epiroc i Kalmar är mitt i den största expansionen i företagets 60-åriga historia till följd av konsolidering av produktion inom koncernen. Idag tillverkar vi världsledande hydrauliska produkter till gruv- och anläggningsindustrin och nu utökar vi detta sortiment vilket innebär tillväxt av såväl kapacitet och personal som omsättning. Vi kommer att ta oss an nya tekniker inom bearbetning och värmebehandling, utöka vår montering och göra vårt tekniska labb redo för att testa och utveckla nya, större produkter. Vi passar också på att modernisera vår materialhantering. Vi har påbörjat en efterlängtad resa och hoppas att du är rätt person att följa med!

Din missionSom Produktionsledare får du en nyckelroll i produktionsledningen och ansvarar för att leda vårt team inom maskinbearbetning. Tillsammans säkerställer ni ett effektivt, hållbart och flexibelt produktionsflöde. Du rapporterar till Produktionschef och är en aktiv del av Produktionens ledningsgrupp, där ni tillsammans skapar produkter och team i världsklass.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat och inkluderande team där samarbete, öppenhet och utveckling är centrala värderingar. Vi arbetar nära varandra över funktionella gränser och tar tillvara på både idéer och insikter från våra medarbetare. Här får du en verklig möjlighet att påverka och bidra till ett säkert, hållbart och effektivt produktionsflöde.

I rollen ansvarar du för ett team om totalt cirka 25 medarbetare i produktionsavsnittet maskinbearbetning. Som ledare ansvarar du för att leda och fördela arbetet mot uppsatta mål samt för att utveckla dina medarbetare genom bland annat medarbetarsamtal, kompetensutveckling och ett aktivt arbetsmiljöarbete. En viktig del av ditt uppdrag är också att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö och en stark sammanhållning i gruppen.

Placering och resorDenna position är placerad i Kalmar, Sverige. Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten.

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.

Ansökan och kontaktI den här rekryteringsprocessen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-16. För frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen eller ansökan vänligen kontakta: Maria Tedsjö, Rekryteringsspecialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com.För frågor om tjänsten vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Lars Björk, acting Production Manager, lars.bjork@epiroc.com



Profile description:

Din profilFör att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område och flera års erfarenhet av ledande arbete i en dynamisk produktionsmiljö. Du har god förståelse för produktionsprocesser gärna med teknisk kompetens.Du har arbetslivserfarenhet från industrin och behärskar svenska flytande samt har goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift.



Som person är du en trygg och närvarande ledare som skapar engagemang genom förtroende, förståelse och delaktighet. Du har förmågan att coacha både individer och team mot gemensamma mål och ser ständiga förbättringar som en naturlig del av vardagen. Du är lösningsorienterad, flexibel och har lätt för att samarbeta, bygga relationer och kommunicera tydligt – även när tempot är högt och förutsättningarna förändras.



Vi värdesätter stort om du har ett intresse för digitalisering och förbättringsarbete samt en vilja att driva utveckling tillsammans med ditt team. Hos oss får du möjlighet att ta ett tydligt ledarskap, påverka arbetssätt och vara med och accelerera transformationen av vår produktion.



Våra ledarskapsförväntningarPå Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare är inspiratörer, pådrivare och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som går före med gott exempel och har modet att utmana det etablerade. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare aktivt främjar säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald, samtidigt som de sätter medarbetarnas välmående och kontinuerliga utveckling i fokus. Vi söker dig som har modet att tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent søkes – meningsfull jobb med mulighet for fast helgestilling eller som tilkalling
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD OSLO OG ROMERIKE
jobs.description:
Er du en positiv, pålitelig og sosial person som ønsker en jobb hvor du faktisk gjør en forskjell? Liker du en variert arbeidshverdag hvor ingen dager er helt like? Da håper jeg du leser videre!

Litt om meg

Jeg er en 50 år gammel mann fra Vestby med to fantastiske gutter på 12 og 9 år. Jeg bruker elektrisk rullestol og har derfor behov for en BPA-assistent som kan bistå meg med praktiske oppgaver i hverdagen. Med riktig assistanse kan jeg bruke mer tid og energi på det som betyr aller mest for meg, å være en aktiv og tilstedeværende pappa, skape gode opplevelser med guttene mine og ha en trygg og velfungerende hverdag. Jeg er en sosial og positiv person som liker å bli kjent med nye mennesker. God kjemi er viktig for meg, og jeg setter pris på en assistent som er trygg på seg selv, har godt humør og liker å samarbeide. Til daglig er jeg i full jobb. Jeg har kontor i Oslo de dagene jeg ikke jobber hjemmefra. På fritiden liker jeg å game, følge fotball og oppleve nye ting. Jeg synes det er gøy å prøve nye restauranter, reise til nye steder og finne på aktiviteter. Jeg er en person som liker fellesskap, gode samtaler og å skape gode minner. Jeg bor i leilighet sentralt i Vestby og har guttene mine annenhver uke (50 %).

Arbeidsoppgaver du kan forvente hos meg:

  • Planlegge, handle inn og tilberede mat.
  • Praktisk bistand i hjemmet og generelle oppgaver i hverdagen.
  • Bistå med personlig stell, inkludert morgen- og kveldsrutiner og intim hygiene.
  • Bli med på turer, aktiviteter og utflukter.
  • Være min forlengede arm når guttene trenger hjelp med praktiske ting.
  • Bidra til at hverdagen flyter godt for meg og familien min.

Som BPA-assistent blir du min høyre hånd i hverdagen. Du skal bidra til at jeg kan leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv, samtidig som jeg får brukt tiden min på familie, jobb og interesser. Stillingen innebærer personlig stell, så det er ønskelig at du er komfortabel med dette. Du vil få god opplæring, og all bistand utføres med respekt, verdighet og gode rutiner.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

  • Du er trygg, positiv og ansvarsfull.
  • Fleksibel og løsningsorientert.
  • Praktisk anlagt, initiativrik og ser hva som bør gjøres.
  • Pålitelig og til å stole på.
  • Har godt humør og liker å omgås mennesker.
  • Trives med både rolige dager og mer aktive perioder.
  • Kanskje er du student eller ønsker en fleksibel deltidsjobb?

Kjemi og personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Jeg kan tilby...

  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du gjør en forskjell i noens hverdag.
  • Et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.
  • God opplæring og oppfølging.
  • En variert jobb hvor du blir kjent med meg og familien min.
  • Fleksible vakter som kan passe ved siden av studier eller annen jobb.
  • Mulighet for fast helgstilling for den rette kandidaten.

Jeg søker deg som kan jobbe...

  • Som generell tilkallingsvikar eller ferievikar ved behov
  • Fast helg på kveldstid en gang i måneden

Arbeidstiden kan variere mellom dag, kveld og helgearbeid.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Førerkort klasse B med automat er en fordel, men ikke et krav siden jeg selv kjører bil.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg, håper jeg du sender inn en søknad! Skriv gjerne litt om deg selv, hva du liker å gjøre, og hvorfor du tror denne jobben passer for deg. Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg og kanskje få deg med på laget!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst at MSD
jobs.description:
MSD Sweden is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to play a critical role in driving data-driven decision-making across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly analytical professional to work at the intersection of commercial strategy, market intelligence, customer analytics, and business performance. The role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders across local Commercial, Marketing, Medical, Finance, and regional and global teams to deliver actionable insights that support growth, enhanced customer engagement, and strategic decision-making.

The Business Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for analyzing market, customer, and competitive data to identify opportunities and trends that inform business strategy. The role will lead the development and maintenance of dashboards, reporting solutions, and centralized data platforms that provide stakeholders with timely and meaningful insights. In addition, the position will support product launches, sales force effectiveness initiatives, omnichannel performance analysis, and forecasting activities through advanced analytics and predictive modeling.

Acting as MSD Sweden's local Data & Analytics point of contact, the successful candidate will drive the adoption of analytics capabilities and help build data literacy across the organization. The role requires strong analytical skills, expertise in business intelligence and visualization tools, and the ability to communicate complex findings to a diverse range of stakeholders.

Success in this position will depend on the ability to lead complex projects, influence cross-functional teams, and translate data into actionable recommendations that support MSD Sweden's commercial and organizational objectives.

jobs.title: Test Engineer to the Production Team
jobs.description:
Scienta Omicron is a leading provider of instruments for surface science and nanotechnology. From its technology centers in Uppsala and Taunusstein, the company develops and manufactures high end systems for electron spectroscopy, scanning probe microscopy and thin film deposition in ultra-high vacuum

Scienta Omicron’s solutions are used by top universities, research institutes and industrial R&D labs worldwide to develop new materials for batteries, quantum technologies, next generation electronics, solar cells and advanced sensors. The technologies have supported several Nobel Prize winning research projects and are available as standard modular systems, “Materials Innovation Platforms” and tailored concepts for specific research needs.

Beyond instruments, Scienta Omicron builds long term partnerships through project planning, system design, equipment training, applications support and upgrades, across more than 30 experimental techniques. This combination of technology and support helps complex research infrastructure deliver value over many years.

We are now adding a new colleague to our Production Team based in Uppsala, Sweden. Our Production Team covers a wide range of functions including instrument assembly, testing, purchasing and managing logistics. This role is a great opportunity to be part of a growing high-tech company, in which you will have a profound influence in delivering world-leading scientific instruments. Our industry is highly international with customers based at Research Agencies and Universities around the world.

This position is responsible for part of the final testing of our instruments before they are delivered to our customers worldwide. Some of the instruments that we produce in Uppsala are the hemispherical photoelectron analyzers DA20, DA30, DFS30, HiPP 3, EW4000, Argus CU and the photon sources SX300, DSX400 and VUV5k.

Your Profile

·      PhD in physics or similar field

·      Experience in using Photo Electron Spectroscopy equipment, and Ultra High Vacuum (UHV) technology

·      Knowledge of instrument testing and production

·      Good understanding of complex technical parts

·      Hands on experience of building UHV systems

·      Proactive and creative problem-solving skills

·      Fluent in business English (verbal and written)

·      Ambition to learn Swedish (if not native)

·      Drive, energy and result oriented team player attributes

The workplace is located at Danmarksgatan 22, Uppsala, Sweden.

jobs.title: Mobiililaiteteknikko ja asiakaspalvelija
jobs.description:
**Haluatko mobiililaitteiden huollon ja asiakaspalvelun mestariksi?**

iTapsan Turun myymälä etsii nyt uusia vahvistuksia riveihinsä asiakaspalvelun ja laitehuollon tehtäviin!

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset auttamaan asiakkaitamme arjen laiteongelmissa sekä huoltamaan mobiililaitteita. Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen, kiinnostunut elektroniikasta ja innokas oppimaan uutta.

**Edellytämme sinulta noin 1-2 vuoden aiempaa kokemusta laitehuollosta ja myymälätyöstä**, jotta pääset sujuvasti mukaan työtehtäviin.

Jos sinulla on intoa korjata tekniikkaa, nautit ihmisten auttamisesta ja haluat työpaikan, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen, laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

iTapsa on yksi Suomen laitehuoltoalan pioneereista olemme huoltaneet puhelimia, tabletteja ja tietokoneita jo vuodesta 2012.

**Mitä pääset tekemään?**

Työsi on monipuolinen yhdistelmä teknistä osaamista ja ensiluokkaista asiakaspalvelua. Olet tärkeä osa myymälämme arkea ja varmistat, että asiakkaat lähtevät meiltä tyytyväisinä.

Päivittäisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu:

- Asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja heidän auttamisensa laiteongelmissa

- Puhelinten, tablettien ja tietokoneiden huolto sekä vikadiagnostiikka

- Uudistettujen laitteiden myynti sekä ostoarvioiden tekeminen

- Huoltotöiden kirjaaminen ja hallinta järjestelmissämme

- Myymälän yleisestä viihtyvyydestä ja sujuvasta asiakaskokemuksesta huolehtiminen


**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeaa asennetta. Vaikka sinulla on jo hieman kokemusta alalta, tärkeintä on aito halu kehittyä ja oppia lisää!

Toivomme sinulta:

- Noin 1-2 vuoden kokemusta laitehuollosta ja myymälätyöstä

- Motivaatiota ja oppimishalua: olet valmis kehittämään osaamistasi ja nautit uuden oppimisesta

- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja: nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja osaat selittää asioita selkeästi

- Huolellisuutta: käsittelet laitteita vastuullisesti ja tarkasti

- Oma-aloitteisuutta: toimit itsenäisesti ja pidät huolen myymälän sujuvasta arjesta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


**Miksi tulla töihin iTapsalle?**

Meillä et ole vain työntekijä, vaan osa rentoa ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

- **Opit arvokkaita taitoja:** kerrytät osaamista asiakaspalvelusta, myymälän pyörittämisestä, laitehuollosta ja myynnistä

- **Kehityt ammattilaisena:** saat monipuolista työkokemusta teknisestä ja asiakaslähtöisestä työstä

- **Rento työilmapiiri:** työskentelet tiimissä, jossa huumori ja hyvä fiilis kulkevat mukana kiireessäkin

- **Kattava perehdytys:** tuemme sinua alusta asti, kunnes hallitset tehtävät itsenäisesti


**Näin haet meille**

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa, laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen myynti@itapsa.com. Kerro meille kuka olet, miksi haluat iTapsalle ja milloin voisit aloittaa. Muistathan laittaa sähköpostin otsikoksi **"Työhakemus iTapsa Turku"**.

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 31.8.2026.

Palkkaus määräytyy kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Workplace Services (RFP & Transition), Espoo
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy leading complex IT projects where organisation, coordination and stakeholder management are key to success?

We're looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to join our client's team and lead a strategic Workplace Services RFP project within a large enterprise IT environment. This is a unique opportunity to drive a business-critical sourcing initiative from planning through execution, with the possibility to continue leading the implementation and transition project during the first half of 2027.

If you enjoy bringing structure to complex environments, working closely with business stakeholders and vendors, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget, this could be the next step in your career.

What you'll be doing

As Project Manager, you'll be responsible for leading the Workplace Services RFP project from start to finish while ensuring successful project delivery according to agreed timelines, budget and governance.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Leading and coordinating the overall RFP project

- Managing project plans, schedules, budgets and reporting

- Coordinating meetings, workshops and steering group activities

- Managing communication with business stakeholders and external vendors

- Coordinating vendor questions and responses throughout the RFP process

- Supporting proposal evaluation and scoring activities

- Following up on deliverables, deadlines and project milestones

- Managing project governance, risks and change management

- Coordinating project resources and dependencies across different teams

- Ensuring project transparency through regular reporting

- Supporting project financial follow-up and value creation

- Ensuring cyber security governance and compliance throughout the project


Should the project continue into 2027, you'll also have the opportunity to lead the implementation and transition of the selected Workplace Services solution.

We're looking for someone with

To succeed in this role, you're an experienced Project Manager who enjoys working in complex enterprise IT environments. You're organised, proactive and comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders while keeping projects moving forward.

You have:

- 5+ years of experience in IT Project Management

- Experience leading enterprise-level IT projects

- Experience managing project budgets, reporting and governance

- Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams

- Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM)

- Understanding of IT service delivery

- Experience working with Workplace Services and Service Desk environments

- Understanding of ServiceNow and service integration concepts

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or another relevant field

- Fluent English language skills (Finnish is considered an advantage)


It's a plus if you also have experience with

- Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) tools

- Transition and transformation projects

- Application Management Services (AMS)

- Enterprise Workplace Services

- Service integration models

- Large-scale outsourcing or sourcing projects

- Cyber security governance within project environments


We believe you'll thrive in this role if you have experience with

- Leading complex enterprise IT projects

- RFP or sourcing projects

- Cross-functional stakeholder management

- Vendor management and contract-related projects

- Service Desk and Workplace Services

- ITSM environments

- ServiceNow

- Managing project governance, risks and reporting

- Driving structured projects with multiple parallel workstreams


Rather than looking for someone who only has traditional project management experience, we're particularly interested in someone who can combine strong organisational skills with an understanding of enterprise IT services and confidently collaborate with both business stakeholders and technical teams.

Additional requirements

To be considered for this role, you must be eligible to successfully complete a Finnish Security Clearance (SUPO).

The role is based in **Espoo**, and the client follows a hybrid working model combining office and remote work.

Recruitment Process

The recruitment process is initially managed by Clevry. We apply continuous selection, and the position may be filled before the application deadline (7.8.2026). We warmly welcome your application already today! For additional information or questions, please contact our Recruitment Manager **Christoffer Pimenoff** (christoffer.pimenoff@clevry.com).

**For this position, you will be employed through Clevry.** The assignment is expected to start during **August 2026**. The initial project runs until **December 2026**, with a strong possibility of extension through **June 2027** to lead the implementation and transition phase.

**Please note!** We only accept applications submitted through our platform and will not respond to applications sent via email.

About Clevry

For over 30 years we have been the change maker for a more soft skills driven work-life within talent acquisition, assessments and advisory. We operate globally with customers, consultants and candidates from North America to Singapore with headquarters in Brighton, Stockholm and Helsinki. At Clevry we have over 150 soft skills certified recruiters, business psychologists and experts at your service.

jobs.title: Assistant Controller, Golf GameBook
jobs.description:
_Golf GameBook is a leading scorecard app with a mission to make golf more fun, easier and simpler for golfers of all levels – on and off the course. Founded in 2007, we set out to modernize golf by replacing traditional paper scorecards with a digital, social experience that brings golfers closer together._

_We believe golf is more than just a game – its about connection, shared moments, and enjoyment both on and off the course. With Golf GameBook, golfers can track live scores, share comments, photos, and videos, and stay connected with their golf community in a fun and effortless way._

_Today, Golf GameBook is used by over 2 million golfers worldwide, with more than 70 million rounds played through the app. As we continue to grow, were always looking for new talent with fresh ideas to help shape the future of golf._

**Would you be our new Assistant Controller?**

As an Assistant Controller, you will join Golf GameBooks finance team in a newly established role created to support our continued growth and international expansion. Working closely with our Head of Finance, you will be involved in a broad range of finance activities and gain a wide understanding of how finance supports a growing international business.

Your responsibilities will include processing sales and purchase invoices, managing daily cash management activities and supporting the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations. Alongside these responsibilities, you will support and develop monthly financial reporting, maintain and develop KPI reporting, and contribute to ad hoc analyses that support business decision-making.

You will also play an active role in developing internal processes and strengthening the internal control environment. As the finance function continues to evolve, you will have the opportunity to participate in reporting development projects and support the implementation of new technologies, including AI-driven solutions.

This is a full-time, permanent position starting as soon as possible. The role is based at our office in Espoo and follows a hybrid working model, with the possibility to work remotely one day per week.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, controlling or auditing, together with a relevant educational background (BSc or MSc). You understand how financial processes work in practice and feel comfortable taking ownership of recurring finance tasks while also contributing to the development of reporting, processes and controls. Experience with Netvisor or a similar financial management system, combined with solid Excel skills, will help you succeed in the role.

Fluency in Finnish and English is required, and Swedish language skills are considered a plus. Experience from a technology company, subscription-based business, or another consumer-focused business environment is considered an advantage. Familiarity with BI tools, data analysis and reporting will help you succeed in the role.

As a person, you are detail-oriented, reliable and proactive. You enjoy working in a growth company where you can take ownership of your work and have a genuine impact on how things are done. We believe you will thrive in this role if you are curious by nature, eager to learn and motivated by developing both processes and your own expertise. While you don't need to be a golfer yourself, an interest in the sport or the industry can help you feel right at home in our team.

**Why us?**

At Golf GameBook, you will join a fast-growing company with Finnish roots and an international reach. This role offers a great balance between familiar financial routines and development-oriented work. As Golf GameBook continues to grow, you will have the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility and make a visible impact on how our finance processes and reporting evolve.

You will work closely with the business in a low-hierarchy and agile environment where ideas can quickly turn into action. We value ownership, initiative and a willingness to challenge existing ways of working.

We offer a competitive set of benefits, including two weeks of paid vacation during your first year of employment, extensive healthcare, golf benefits, gym membership, commuter benefits, and more! After your probation period, you can also work remotely from abroad for up to one month per year.

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link no later than 23.8.2026. We will start interviewing candidates during the application period.

jobs.title: Enhetschef
jobs.description:
Statens tjänstepensionsverk, SPV, är en av Sveriges största leverantörer av pensionstjänster. Vi hanterar tjänstepensioner och försäkringar åt arbetsgivare på det statliga området och har över 1 100 000 kunder både statligt anställda, före detta statligt anställda och pensionärer. Vårt kontor finns i Sundsvall.

Kom med oss och skapa samhällsnytta. Vi är en myndighet som vill göra tjänstepension enkelt för alla som är eller har varit statligt anställda. Vårt fokus är våra kunder, handlingskraft och nytänkande. Att jobba tillsammans i hela organisationen tror vi är en viktig nyckel för att göra ett bra jobb med hög kvalitet.

Nu söker vi en enhetschef till en av våra enheter.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Att vara chef på SPV innebär att du är en statlig arbetsgivarföreträdare. Med uppdraget som chef på SPV följer ett ansvar att se till att verksamheten bedrivs effektivt, säkert och med god kvalitet och service. Allt enligt den statliga värdegrunden och den arbetsgivarpolitiska delegeringen.

Inom ramen för ditt uppdrag behöver du som ledare ta ansvar för att agera utifrån en helhetssyn och alltid se till myndighetens bästa. Chefen ansvarar också för att risker inom ansvarsområdet identifieras och hanteras. Som enhetschef på SPV har du personal- och budgetansvar för dina medarbetare samt ansvar att säkerställa att de team som ingår i din enhet levererar enligt plan.

Du leder en enhet bestående av cirka 15 medarbetare. Medarbetarna är indelade i team där varje team har en teamledare. Inom enheten finns idag team Fastställa underlag och team Grunduppgifter och valcentral. Arbetsuppgifterna spänner över ett brett område och omfattar bland annat att ta in och kvalitetssäkra anställningsuppgifter, fastställa pensionsgrundande arbetstid och administrera val och flytt av premier.

Du som söker den här tjänsten ska ha vilja och förmåga att även leda annan verksamhet på SPV och ha en ambition att utvecklas i din chefsroll för att kunna ta dig an andra områden i framtiden.

Du arbetar aktivt med kompetensförsörjningsfrågor för att säkra kompetens och förmågor på kort och lång sikt. Dels genom att kontinuerligt analysera kompetensen inom din enhet i relation till SPV:s långsiktiga behov och dels genom din medverkan i SPV:s kompetensledning. Där arbetar du tillsammans med andra enhetschefer och tar ett gemensamt ansvar för vår övergripande kompetensförsörjning på både strategisk och taktisk nivå.

Du uppmuntrar till ett prestigelöst och konstruktivt samarbete och skapar förutsättningar för att utveckla både gruppen och individerna i gruppen. Arbetsmiljöarbete ligger dig varmt om hjärtat och du är en god kommunikatör som skapar mening, arbetsglädje och sammanhang genom framför allt dialog.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har en akademisk examen inom ett för tjänsten relevant område alternativt erfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig. Du har mångårig erfarenhet av ledarskap med personalansvar. Du har även mycket goda kunskaper i svenska samt goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att:

    • leda stora personalgrupper
    • leda i teambaserad organisation
    • leda och arbeta inom offentlig förvaltning leda i förändring

För att lyckas i det här uppdraget är dina personliga egenskaper mycket viktiga och vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dem i den här rekryteringen.

Som person:

    • har du ledarskapsförmåga. Du kan leda och motivera för att effektivt nå gemensamma mål. Du samordnar grupper och blir en referenspunkt för andra och du skapar engagemang och delaktighet.
    • har du god samarbetsförmåga. Du arbetar bra med andra människor och relaterar till dem på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt. Du lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser eventuella konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.
    • har du en helhetssyn. Du ser helheter och tar hänsyn till det större perspektivet. Du förstår din roll, men ser till hela verksamhetens bästa när du agerar och tar beslut.
    • har du ett gott omdöme. Du gör korrekta avvägningar och prioriteringar. Du väger samman komplex information och olika typer av hänsynstaganden och visar gott omdöme vid uttalanden, agerande och beslut.
    • är du flexibel. Du har lätt för att anpassa dig till ändrade omständigheter. Du kan snabbt ändra ditt synsätt och förhållningssätt. Du ser också möjligheterna i förändringar.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. .

Hos oss blir du varmt välkomnad. Här jobbar 250 engagerade personer och vi tycker det är viktigt att du trivs hos oss. Vi är öppna för nya idéer, vår omvärld och mot varandra. Och vi gillar att testa nytt och har ett starkt driv framåt. Vi ser rekrytering som en långsiktig investering och tycker det är viktigt att du som medarbetare mår bra, har balans i livet och ges möjlighet att utveckla dina talanger.

Vi jobbar på en flexibel arbetsplats, både i härliga lokaler och med möjlighet att jobba hemifrån på 50 procent om du vill. I SPV-huset rekommenderar vi en fika i vår vinterträdgård eller varför inte en stund i vårt fräscha gym. Dessutom har vi olika friskvårdsaktiviteter du kan delta i då det finns något för alla. Vi strävar efter mångfald och att ha ett inkluderande synsätt på alla nivåer i organisationen.

Vår verksamhet vilar på den gemensamma statliga värdegrunden. Den är en grundläggande utgångspunkt för oss, oavsett vad vi arbetar med. Demokrati är den överordnade principen i värdegrunden och medborgarna är vår yttersta uppdragsgivare. Övriga principer i den statliga värdegrunden är legalitet, objektivitet, fri åsiktsbildning, respekt samt effektivitet och service.

SPV har individuell och differentierad lönesättning som tillämpas i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T. Mer information om oss som arbetsgivare och de anställningsförmåner du erbjuds finns under Om att jobba på SPV på SPV.se.

En säkerhetsprövning kan komma att genomföras. Mer information om vad säkerhetsprövning innebär kan du få här: https://sakerhetspolisen.se/sakerhetsskydd/registerkontroll.html

Vi avsäger oss vänligen men bestämt, alla erbjudanden om hjälp med annonsering och rekrytering.

jobs.title: Infirmier(ère) en chef
jobs.description:
Description de l'emploi:

En tant qu’infirmier(ère) en chef au Richemont, vous avez l’opportunité de mettre à profit votre expertise au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire. Vous jouez un rôle de coach pour l’équipe, avec une approche bienveillante et soutenante. Une attention particulière est accordée au suivi optimal des résidents, à la collaboration avec les familles et les médecins, ainsi qu’à la garantie d’une qualité de soins élevée.

Missions :

  • Soutenir et coacher les infirmiers(ères) et les aides-soignant(e)s ;
  • Coordonner et assurer le suivi des plans de soins des résidents ;
  • Observer, suivre et rapporter les changements dans l’état de santé ;
  • Être le point de contact pour les résidents, les familles et les médecins ;
  • Assurer des tâches administratives avec un accent sur l’exactitude de l’encodage et la gestion des dossiers.
Ce que nous offrons:

Chez Korian, nous prenons soin les uns des autres avec le cœur, dans le respect du bien-être et de la dignité de chacun. Notre philosophie Positive Care repose sur la joie de vivre, l’hospitalité et une attention sincère, et constitue le fondement de notre accompagnement. Elle guide à la fois notre relation avec les résidents et notre manière de collaborer entre collègues. Avec cette philosophie comme fil conducteur, nous ne sommes pas un employeur ordinaire, mais une organisation où l’esprit d’équipe et la collaboration occupent une place centrale.

En outre, nous vous offrons :

  • Un CDI à temps plein ;
  • Un salaire conforme au marché selon les barèmes IFIC, avec reprise de l’ancienneté pertinente ;
  • Une participation à l’élaboration de votre horaire ;
  • Des chèques-repas, une indemnité de déplacements domicile-travail et des réductions via Benefits at Work ;
  • Un environnement de travail sûr et sain, avec une attention particulière au bien-être, à la santé et à la sécurité ;
  • Des opportunités d’initiative et de développement professionnel via la Korian Academy ;
  • Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée ;
  • Une équipe engagée, toujours présente les uns pour les autres.
À propos de l'entreprise:

Korian est l’un des plus grands prestataires de soins en Belgique dans le domaine des soins résidentiels aux personnes âgées, avec près de 120 maisons de repos, résidences-services, centres de soins de jour, séjours de revalidation et unités psychogériatriques. Tous nos sites sont certifiés ISO 9001.
En outre, nous proposons également des services de soins à domicile, de soins infirmiers à domicile et de titres-services, afin d’accompagner en toute sécurité les personnes, jeunes et moins jeunes, également dans leur environnement de vie habituel.

Dans notre travail, le Positive Care est au cœur de tout : une philosophie de soins qui repose sur l’idée que chacun est unique et a droit à une attention sincère, à la joie de vivre, à l’hospitalité et à la participation.
Nous créons des environnements chaleureux et familiaux où les résidents peuvent vieillir dans la dignité et où le vivre-ensemble est palpable.
Nos équipes travaillent au plus près des résidents, se soutiennent mutuellement et bénéficient de confiance, d’autonomie et de responsabilités pour exercer leur métier avec cœur et expertise.
C’est ainsi que, ensemble, nous construisons au sein de notre groupe des soins humains, chaleureux et tournés vers l’avenir.

Exigences:

En tant qu’infirmier(ère) en chef, vous contribuez au Positive Care, à la planification des soins et au suivi des parcours de soins. Vous soutenez et accompagnez les aides-soignant(e)s et collaborez avec vos collègues pour offrir des soins personnalisés et de qualité, en entretenant un lien étroit avec les résidents et leurs familles.

Le sens clinique, les compétences en communication et le sens des responsabilités sont essentiels dans cette fonction. Ces compétences vous permettent de coordonner les soins, de traduire les observations en actions appropriées, de prendre des décisions fondées et d’être un interlocuteur clé au sein de l’équipe et vis-à-vis des partenaires externes.

Votre profil :

  • Bachelier en soins infirmiers (visa requis) ;
  • L’expérience n’est pas requise, mais constitue un atout ;
  • Aisance dans le suivi des plans de soins et la collaboration multidisciplinaire ;
  • Bonne connaissance du français;
  • Flexible et résistant(e) au stress ;
  • Organisé(e) et structuré(e) dans le travail quotidien ;
  • Rigoureux(se) dans l’encodage et la gestion des dossiers ;
  • Orienté(e) qualité et amélioration continue des soins.


Environnement de travail :

Horaire variable avec travail en shifts en semaine ;
Disponibilité pour le travail le week-end (en moyenne 1 week-end sur 4).

**Kunnossapitoinsinöörinä** tehtäväsi on tehtaan kunnossapidon kehittäminen, tukeminen operatiivisen kunnossapidon koordinoinnissa- ja työnsuunnittelussa. Tehtävässä osallistut tai vastaat kunnossapitoprojekteista yhdessä sidosryhmien kanssa. Tehtävään kuuluu myös sekä ennakkohuoltojen ja tarkastusten koordinointi ja kehittäminen. Suunnittelet myös proaktiivisesti ja ennakoiden kunnossapitotoimenpiteitä pidemmälle tulevaisuuteen. Lisäksi vastuullasi tulee olemaan kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ylläpito ja kehittäminen. Tässä mielenkiintoisessa tehtävässä pääset ottamaan vastuuta kunnossapidon kehittämisestä yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.

**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Teknistä koulutusta (insinööri tai vastaava)

- Kokemusta kunnossapidosta valmistavassa -tai prosessiteollisuudessa

- Ymmärrystä ja näkemystä kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmistä

- Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito


Raportoit tehtävässäsi Ponssen tehtaan kunnossapitopäällikölle. Aloitus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager- UK
jobs.description:
We’re building the AI-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth!

We’re building the AI-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth! Gainsight is the AI-powered retention engine behind the world’s most customer-centric companies. The Gainsight CustomerOS platform orchestrates the customer journey from onboarding to outcomes to advocacy. More than 2,000 companies trust Gainsight’s applications and AI agents to drive learning, adoption, community connection, and success for their customers. To explore how our suite of solutions is shaping the future of customer success, check out the link.

About This Role:

We’re looking for a full-time Technical Project Manager to join our Professional Services team, reporting to the SEM Manager. This role is a Hybrid role based in the UK.

In this role, you’ll play a key role in driving successful enterprise-level implementations of the Gainsight platform for our customers by owning the end-to-end onboarding and delivery lifecycle. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment and enjoys working cross-functionally with teams like Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. The ideal candidate brings strong skills in enterprise project management, stakeholder communication, and enterprise software implementation.

What You'll Do:

  • Execute complex software implementation projects while partnering closely with executive-level client sponsors to ensure alignment on scope, timeline, and desired business outcomes.

  • Drive onboarding efforts for new and existing customers, prescribing best-practice recommendations that tie directly to their objectives.

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and communication cadences to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery.

  • Track project scope and, when necessary, estimate and execute change orders in partnership with the customer.

  • Produce comprehensive weekly status reports and executive communications to keep internal and external stakeholders informed.

  • Proactively identify project risks and issues, developing and executing mitigation plans to maintain project health.

  • Coach and mentor project team members (often across multiple time zones) to facilitate effective teamwork and knowledge transfer.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Professional Services by creating templates, policies, and tools that scale our delivery capabilities.

This is not a complete list of responsibilities, and the scope of the role may evolve with the needs of the team and business.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelors Degree (or equivalent experience, preferably with Project Management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) and/or 5 years of related experience

  • 5+ years of experience managing enterprise-grade software implementation or professional services projects, or in a related customer-facing consulting role.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional, geographically dispersed project teams of up to 5 members on engagements valued at $0.5M+.

  • In-depth knowledge of both waterfall and agile project management methodologies and tools.

  • Executive presence with highly developed communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Proven ability to create structure in ambiguous situations and design effective delivery processes.

  • Experience working with complex, multi-divisional, multi-geographical customers.

  • Up to 10-15% travel for customer onsite meetings.

  • Prior experience implementing Customer Success or CRM platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Salesforce) preferred.

  • Exposure to SaaS business models and metrics preferred

Why You’ll Love It Here:

Gainsight is a place where innovation is shaped through collaboration, curiosity, and a shared focus on solving real-world problems. With a growing suite of products across customer success, product experience, community, education, and AI-powered relationship intelligence, we continue to evolve with the needs of our customers. When people with diverse strengths, a strong sense of community, and true passion for our mission come together, they drive greater impact and create lasting value. What underpins it all is a culture that offers the stability, trust, and support that people need - not just to do the job, but to show up as themselves and feel connected to the work they do. Gainsters love working here for several reasons. Here are a few:

Our Compensation and Benefits: At Gainsight, we believe great work happens when teammates feel fully supported.

  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including private medical, dental, and vision coverage, income protection, life insurance, and a group pension plan. Additional benefits include a fertility stipend, access to coworking spaces around the globe and CycleScheme to support healthy commuting. You'll also enjoy dedicated Recharge Holidays - one long weekend each quarter to relax and reset.


Our Core Values: We are guided by our values and our mission to be living proof you can win in business while being Human-First. Learn more here.

 

Our Growth Opportunities: From mentoring to career development opportunities, we’re passionate about helping our teammates learn, grow, and thrive.

 

Our Parody Videos: No explanation needed. Just watch them here!

 

If this sounds like the right role for you, we’d love to hear from you.

 
 

Additional Information:

We’re committed to creating an inclusive, fair, and transparent hiring process. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a welcoming experience for all candidates.

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in London. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

  • Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

  • Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

  • Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

  • Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

  • Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

  • Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

  • Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

THE ROLE

The Transaction Monitoring (TM) Compliance Manager is a specialized financial crime risk and regulatory oversight role within the Second Line of Defence (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance department. The successful candidate is responsible for providing independent oversight, objective evaluation, and compliance challenges regarding the efficacy of the firm's Transaction Monitoring framework.

Acting as a Second Line Subject Matter Expert (SME), the individual defines the regulatory envelope, assesses TM risk coverage, and reviews the governance, methodologies, and documentation underpinning detection mechanisms. This role does not own control execution or technical solution design; instead, it provides independent assurance to ensure that the firm’s monitoring practices remain aligned with defined risk appetite, internal policies, and global regulatory expectations (AML/CTF/CPF).


Key Responsibilities:


1. Compliance Oversight in Risk Assessment & Horizon Scanning

  • Independent Review: Lead the ongoing 2LoD evaluation and challenge of the Compliance Risk Assessments (including EWRA and Product Risk Assessments) to ensure they accurately reflect current transaction data, typologies, and product utilization trends.

  • Regulatory Surveying & Horizon Scanning: Proactively monitor, survey, and analyze shifts in the global regulatory landscape, financial crime trends, and regulatory enforcement actions to ensure the firm's TM Compliance risk assessment framework remains comprehensive and defensible.

  • Gap Assurance: Evaluate the mapping of financial crime typologies against active transaction monitoring coverage to independently identify and escalate potential tracking gaps to senior management.

2. Independent Compliance Challenge & Assurance Framework

  • Segmentation & Calibration Challenge: Provide independent, 2LoD challenge to data-driven customer segmentation methodologies executed by the First Line (1LoD), verifying alignment with merchant risk profiles.

  • Compliance Oversight in Tuning & Optimization: Review and evaluate the methodologies, statistical testing parameters, and documentation for periodic "Below-the-Line" (BTL) and "Above-the-Line" (ATL) testing performed by the First Line to ensure robust governance.

  • Residual Risk Opining: Formulate independent compliance opinions regarding residual risk acceptance, providing formal advisory input to governance forums and the Global MLROs.

3. Governance, Risk, & Reporting

  • Model Risk Governance: Participate in the compliance review of TM systems and model validation exercises, independently assessing the transparency, logic, and regulatory defensibility of detection models against applicable guidance (e.g., FCA guidance on model risk management).

  • Strategic Alignment: Provide regulatory compliance support to the Head of TM to assist in aligning roadmap initiatives with the compliance maturity framework.

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with cross-functional stakeholders across lines of defense to communicate compliance requirements and support the adherence to established TM standards.

  • Governance & Escalation Paths: Support the enhancement of the TM compliance governance framework to facilitate the structured, independent escalation of risk metrics to senior management.

  • Metrics & KRI Oversight: Assist in the production of 2LoD Management Information (MI) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to track the effectiveness of the compliance oversight posture for the Head of TM and Global MLRO.

3. Data Integrity & Alert Lifecycle Assurance

  • Data Lineage Assurance: Review documentation regarding data lineage, integrity, and completeness for feeds ingested into the monitoring architecture to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Lifecycle Evaluation: Evaluate the end-to-end alert workflow governance, risk scoring frameworks, and prioritization mechanics to ensure high-risk alerts adhere to compliant escalation paths.

  • Feedback Loops: Analyze high-level alert outcomes and disposition trends to provide compliance feedback loops to technical teams, supporting iterative improvements in the quality of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: Typically 5+ years of experience within Financial Crime Compliance, with a specific focus on the independent oversight, assurance, or evaluation of Transaction Monitoring frameworks within a regulated PSP, FinTech, or financial institution.

  • 2LoD Competency: Proven experience operating within a Second Line of Defence capacity, demonstrating the ability to independently challenge technical teams, data models, and threshold tuning documentation objectively.

  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the UK Money Laundering Regulations (MLRs), JMLSG Guidance, and international FATF standards.

  • Systems & Data Literacy: Familiarity with data analysis methodologies, data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau), or basic query languages (e.g., SQL) sufficient to independently evaluate data testing outputs, methodologies, and audit trails.

  • Education & Professional Certifications: A Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Criminology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Professional certifications from recognized bodies (e.g., ICA International Diploma in AML, ACAMS) are highly regarded.

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

We are looking for a seasoned IT Engineer II to join our Engineering team. At this level, you have developed your skill set to confidently tackle all but the most complex problems affecting the team. You will lead the delivery of essential IT services and small to medium-sized projects, either independently or by guiding other engineers.

 

As an Engineer II, you are an individual contributor with a deep understanding of your team’s purpose and how it impacts Checkout as a whole. You will act as an owner-operator, taking accountability for the success of the systems within your area of responsibility.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Project Leadership: Independently design and deliver project-level work with minimal guidance from senior engineers.

  • Atlassian Mastery: Act as a subject matter expert for our Workplace Technology stack, with a specific focus on high-level administration and optimisation of Jira and Confluence.

  • Endpoint & Infrastructure: Provide advanced technical support and policy management for macOS and Windows endpoints using Jamf and Microsoft Intune.

  • Operational Excellence: Provide an advanced level of operational support on team-owned services and train new members on service design, security, and operations.

  • Incident Response: Display urgency and accountability during incidents, triaging and supporting complex flows unaided.

  • Mentorship: Regularly support and mentor less experienced engineers, helping to raise the technical quality of the team.

  • Automation: Proactively recognise areas for improvement and suggest automated solutions (Python/PowerShell) to reduce incidental complexity.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Typically 2–3+ years of experience in an IT Engineering or similar technical role.

  • Technical Expertise: Experience with Identity Providers (Okta, Azure AD) and protocols like SAML and SCIM.

  • Advanced Atlassian Skills: High-level experience managing the Atlassian suite. You should be comfortable with complex Jira configurations, workflow customisations, and permission schemes.

  • Problem Solving: A logical approach to troubleshooting, with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs between different solutions.

  • Ownership: A proactive "owner-operator" mindset—you take responsibility for your tasks and the long-term health of the systems you manage.

  • Communication: Ability to communicate effectively with company stakeholders and resolve complex support queries within your area of focus.

Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where you can balance temporary workarounds with flexible, long-term architectural solutions

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: Principal Procurement Lead, Compute and Storage
jobs.description:
About Radiant

As part of the Infrastructure team, we are seeking a highly strategic, technically fluent, and commercially astute Principal Procurement Lead, Compute and Storage. In this role, you will own the end-to-end procurement strategy, engage with vendor ecosystems, and contribute to commercial negotiations for our highest-value capital investments. This includes high-density GPU clusters, high-performance network fabrics, storage, and our upcoming site connectivity.

You will serve as the primary bridge between our internal Infrastructure teams and the world's leading technology OEMs (e.g. Nvidia, HPE, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro…) and storage vendors (Weka, Vast, DDN…). Your mission is to build the most effective and resilient supply chain to support the implementation of our Technology roadmap, optimize our clusters’ Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and mitigate global supply chain risks for massive, cutting-edge computing infrastructure deployments.

About the Role

We are expanding our footprint of AI factories and GPU clusters. This role runs procurement for the compute and storage category, globally. That covers GPU systems, servers, racks, networking within the rack, and storage platforms.

You own the path from technical design to signed commercial package. You deal directly with the leading compute and storage OEMs, and internally with Architecture, Technical Operations, Commercial and Finance. Individual packages run from a few million dollars to nine figures.

Our procurement model splits by category area, and further leads will follow as we scale. This is the first of those roles. You set the standards the rest inherit.

What You'll Do

  • Own category strategy for compute and storage, refreshed each quarter against the technology roadmap.

  • Structure, issue and score RFIs and RFPs. Requirement capture through to purchase order.

  • Own the price book for every vendor in your category. Line-item level, version controlled, and the source Finance uses for CapEx forecasts.

  • Validate every bill of materials before a purchase order goes out. You run that review across Architecture, Technical Operations, Commercial and Finance.

  • Negotiate commercial terms. Volume discounts, maintenance, software bundling, freight, delivery windows.

  • Normalise competing bids into one comparable CapEx position per configuration, and hand that to Finance for TCO and unit economics.

  • Run quarterly supplier scorecards and hold the escalation path into each vendor account team.

  • Publish a monthly lead time and allocation view for Infrastructure and DC Development. You flag slippage before it reaches a build schedule.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years in strategic sourcing, category management or technical supply chain. At least three years on IT infrastructure hardware.

  • Direct negotiation with hardware OEMs on capital purchases above $10m.

  • You can read a server bill of materials and challenge it. Wrong part numbers, missing optics and cables, undersized drives, support lines that do not match the service terms.

  • You build the CapEx and vendor cost models Finance relies on. Every line traceable to a quote, and you defend the inputs in review.

  • You hold a position against a vendor account team under time pressure.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in HPC, AI infrastructure, hyperscale datacentres or cloud infrastructure.

  • CIPS or CPSM.

  • Sourcing under allocation constraint. GPUs, HBM, optics.

Why Join Radiant

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry.

  • Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

  • Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

  • Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

  • Collaborate with experienced operators, investors and technologists.

jobs.title: Cluster Architect
jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

As part of the Infrastructure Solutions team, the Cluster Architect is the tip of the spear leading Radiant’s new GPU deployments. The Cluster Architect contributes to the technical strategy, reference architecture, and governance standards underpinning Radiant's GPU compute platform. They translate the high-level designs provided by the Customer Success organization into fully operational supercomputers. In conjunction with the Datacenter Engineering team, they lead the definition of the low-level design of upcoming high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure deployments.

You must be a solution finder, able to adapt to evolving technology and customer requirements, and be ready to handle scale. The right person for this role will be technically focused and detail-oriented, and able to work with the broader team to successfully deliver some of the world’s largest supercomputers at a rapid pace with precision. It is critical to document each step of the process to enable effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

About the Infrastructure Team

The Infrastructure Engineering team spearheads the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of critical HPC/AI infrastructure to the broader Technology and Customer organizations. Its mission is to deploy scalable, secure, and efficient infrastructure solutions tailored to the organization's strategic needs. The team defines Radiant’s supercomputers’ reference architecture in line with the customer, software, and operational requirements of the company.

They work closely with third-party suppliers to provide and maintain the list of technologies that form part of Radiant’s portfolio of offerings.

They provide technical support throughout the procurement process with vendors to ensure the suitability of RFI/RFP responses.


They work in tandem with OEMs and infrastructure providers during the infrastructure rollout, and providing technical inputs to DC providers and OEMs

They work closely with the program management office, and align the hardware infrastructure rollout programs with the parallel datacenter fitout and software engineering programs.

They play an instrumental role in the successful deployments of cloud infrastructure, whilst ensuring optimal performance and reliability for high-demand computing environments. Once accepted, the infrastructure solutions are then handed over to the Infrastructure Operations team who manages the daily management of the infrastructure.

What you’ll do

  • Engage with key stakeholders (such as the Program Management Office, Data Center Engineering, Solutions Engineering and Infrastructure Operations teams) and translate inputs into Radiant’s reference architecture and low-level designs blueprints.

  • Remain abreast of technology advancements and roadmaps with key vendors in the space.

  • Lead the low-level design of high-density AI supercomputer systems (compute, interconnect, storage, management).

  • Participate in the Architecture Review Board involving key stakeholders to ensure collaboration and company alignment behind the designs being produced.

  • Evaluate tradeoffs between performance, power, cooling, serviceability, and cost throughout the procurement process.

  • In tandem with potential suppliers, drive the creation of detailed low-level designs, including (but not limited to):

    • Rack elevation diagrams and layouts

    • Data center floor plans and spatial planning

    • Power distribution and cooling architecture and related detailed specifications

    • Detailed Bill of Materials (BoM)

    • Port mapping documents.

  • Drive thorough technical evaluations and response accuracy from vendors during the RFx processes, ensuring designs are aligned with vendor capabilities and long-lead item constraints.

  • Play a hands-on and pro-active role in the manufacturing, burn-in, cabling, logical configuration, benchmarking, and logical implementation of new deployments to turn designs into production-grade systems.

  • Drive acceptance criteria with quality, reliability, safety, and performance goals in mind.

  • Work with the Software Engineering and Solutions Engineering teams to ensure the infrastructure supports AI workload requirements.

  • Engage with project management to define milestones, risks, resourcing, and deliverables associated with the delivery.

  • Produce accurate architecture diagrams, configuration documentation, runbooks, and operational guidance to facilitate the handover of the new deployments to the Infrastructure Operations team.

  • Establish delivery best practices and continuously improve the designs, processes, and documentation through the participation of “lessons learned” workshops.

Requirements

  • BSc in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or other related Engineering fields.

  • 5+ years of solution architecture experience, demonstrating motivation and skills to drive technical design and delivery processes.

  • Deep expertise in datacenter engineering (mechanical, electrical and plumbing), GPU systems, high performance networking (like InfiniBand), including a proven understanding of network topologies and storage architecture.

  • Proficiency in system-level aspects, encompassing Operating Systems, Linux kernel drivers, GPUs, NICs, and infrastructure software solutions.

  • Demonstrated experience producing detailed infrastructure designs (including network topologies, rack layouts, BoMs, power/cooling planning…)

  • Deep understanding in datacenter fit-out, and power/cooling constraints

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a track record interfacing with various types of stakeholders (engineering/operations teams, vendors, etc.) and writing clear deliverables.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving, high-complexity technical environments.

Nice to have

  • Prior work experience in HPC, Telco, or hyperscale supercomputing environments designing, delivering, and/or operating large scale HPC systems.

  • Work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center designs.

  • Familiarity with monitoring/telemetry systems and observability for infrastructure health.

  • Demonstrated expertise in cloud orchestration software and job schedulers, including platforms like Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, and HPC-specific schedulers such as Slurm.

  • Knowledge of DevOps/MLOps technologies such as Docker/containers, Kubernetes, datacenter compute/network/storage deployments.

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA systems/SDKs (e.g., CUDA), NVIDIA Networking technologies (e.g., DPU, RoCE, InfiniBand), ARM CPU solutions, coupled with proficiency in C/C++ programming, parallel programming, and GPU development.

 

Why should you join us?

 

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

 

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

  • This role is key to supporting bunch's growth going forward. You will establish and execute our commercial strategy with Enterprise customers, including VC and PE funds, leading to bunch becoming the industry standard for private market investments.

  • A successful hire will contribute to setting our Commercial strategy at pace. You will play a key role in building further market knowledge and relations with potential VC customers, supporting bunch during a pivotal time.

Top responsibilities

  • Acquire new Enterprise customers across our markets (inbound and outbound).

  • Build and maintain relationships between bunch and i) General Partners (GPs) / CFOs / COOs of prospect and client funds, and ii) Angel investors.

  • Understand the pain points faced by prospects and customers to develop account plans for specific lists of target accounts, including demand generation and closing plans.
