jobs.title: Clinical Coordination Manager
jobs.description:
Department: Support Operations

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
  • Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

  • Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
  • Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
  • Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
  • Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
  • Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
  • Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
  • Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
  • Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
  • Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

  • Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
  • Clinical Days at Goal
  • 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
  • Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
  • Schedule-entry timeliness
  • Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
  • Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
  • Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
  • Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

  • Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
  • Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
  • Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

jobs.title: Risk & Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Why Polar?

It's never been easier to build, ship and scale software.

But it's never been harder to monetize it.

Modern startups look fundamentally different than prior generations:

  • Smaller teams
  • Exponential revenue growth relative to headcount
  • Higher variability in costs (LLMs) requiring more frequent pricing iterations
  • Laser focused on product development and distribution
  • Delegating and automating everything that is boilerplate â be it in their codebase or business operations.

Exceptional billing primitives, APIs and SDKs are essential, but delightful integration is not enough.

Startups need a billing platform designed for their speed of iteration. Combining billing and analytics in one platform to offer customer- and feature unit economics in real-time. Offering built-in pricing and cost insights, simulations and optimizations while simultaneously handling international compliance, tax management, fraud prevention and more.

That's Polar. We're building the next standard for applied AI startups.

Join our small, talented and engineering-led team across Europe as we build the infrastructure powering the next generation of software companies.

We focus on shipping at high velocity to serve startup founders scale their businesses. Everything else is secondary.

Role & responsibilities: What you will do

As a Risk & Compliance Specialist, you'll help protect the integrity of the Polar platform by reviewing merchants, identifying potential risks, and ensuring compliance with our policies and payment partner requirements. You'll partner closely with Merchant Support, Product, and Operations to balance a seamless merchant experience with effective risk management.

We're a small team, so you'll have the opportunity to do more than review accounts. You'll help improve our processes, identify emerging risk trends, and shape how Risk Operations scales as Polar grows.

You'll work with the team to:

  • Review new merchant applications and assess eligibility to sell on the Polar platform.
  • Conduct ongoing account reviews to identify changes in merchant activity or risk profile.
  • Evaluate merchants for compliance with Polar's Acceptable Use Policy and other platform requirements.
  • Investigate fraud, payment risk signals, disputes, chargebacks, and other suspicious activity.
  • Manage merchant offboarding, payout holds, and other risk-mitigation actions as needed.
  • Partner with payment providers and internal teams to resolve compliance and account-related issues.
  • Document review decisions and maintain clear, consistent internal processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve risk workflows, tooling, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor emerging abuse trends and escalate complex or high-risk cases to leadership.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, making thoughtful decisions, and protecting the platform's integrity. You're analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with ambiguity while balancing merchant experience with compliance requirements.

You have excellent judgment, communicate clearly, and can explain difficult decisions with empathy and professionalism.

Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in Risk Operations, Trust & Safety, Compliance, Fraud Operations, Payments, or Merchant Operations.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to explain complex decisions clearly and professionally.
  • Experience reviewing accounts, investigating fraud, or evaluating merchant risk.
  • Ability to prioritize competing priorities and make consistent, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Support, Product, and external payment partners.
  • Familiarity with SQL for investigating data, validating risk signals, and answering operational questions is a plus.

90-day Plan & Milestones

First 30 Days - Learning

â Learn Polar's products, merchant onboarding flow, and Merchant of Record model.

â Become familiar with the Acceptable Use Policy, internal review guidelines, and risk workflows.

â Shadow merchant reviews, investigations, and offboarding processes.

â Begin reviewing low-risk merchant applications with guidance.

First 60 Days - Implementing

â Independently review new merchant applications and ongoing account reviews.

â Investigate fraud signals, disputes, and payment risk cases.

â Manage standard offboarding cases and payout holds.

â Start contributing to improvements in documentation and review processes.

First 90 Days - Contributing

â Own merchant reviews from initial assessment through final decision, ensuring every case is well documented and consistently applied.

â Handle more complex risk and compliance cases.

â Identify trends and recommend operational improvements.

â Partner with Product, Support, and Operations to improve workflows and the merchant experience.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Assistant
jobs.description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

SANY Northern Europe AB is looking for an experienced Senior Finance Manager to take professional responsibility for financial management, reporting and internal control relating to the company. This is a senior individual-contributor position.

The role includes close cooperation with local management, external accounting providers, auditors, tax advisers and the group headquarters. The position also supports financial risk management and internal-control activities.

Key responsibilities

    Coordinate financial management, accounting and reporting activities across relevant subsidiaries and legal entities.
    Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports, including statutory reporting and tax compliance.
    Manage budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow monitoring and financial-performance analysis.
    Review closing activities, payments, reconciliations and accounting records to ensure accuracy and compliance.
    Coordinate cross-border settlements, intercompany transactions and transfer-pricing matters.
    Develop and improve financial processes, approval procedures, risk controls and internal-control frameworks.
    Support audits, major contracts, investments and management decisions through financial and risk analysis.
    Cooperate with banks, auditors, tax advisers, external accountants, local management and group headquarters.
    Report financial results, key risks and recommendations to relevant management stakeholders.

Qualifications and experience

    Bachelor’s degree or higher in accounting, finance, economics, business administration or a related field.
    Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in financial management, accounting, audit, internal control or corporate finance.
    Extensive international finance experience across different countries, legal entities and regulatory environments.
    Proven experience independently coordinating the financial activities of overseas subsidiaries.
    Strong knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, cash-flow management, taxation, compliance and internal controls.
    Experience with cross-border payments, intercompany transactions, transfer pricing and group reporting.
    Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently across several jurisdictions.
    Professional working proficiency in English.
    Mandarin Chinese is an advantage due to regular coordination with group headquarters.
    Swedish, Dutch, German or another European language is considered an advantage.
    Experience from an international manufacturing, industrial or machinery company is an advantage.

Personal qualities

You are structured, responsible and analytical, with strong professional integrity. You are comfortable working independently in an international environment and can communicate financial matters clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

We're searching for individuals with an analytical mindset, strong critical thinking skills, and a knack for meeting deadlines while efficiently managing their time.



Join us and kickstart your career with unparalleled opportunities for professional development and advancement within our dynamic organization.



Who we are:

DANX Carousel Group is a leading logistics specialist focused on time-critical solutions that aims to redefine industry standards. Our continuous focus on innovation, customer satisfaction, and market expansion has been instrumental in our growth. Our commercial entities operate across 35 countries, with offices strategically located throughout mainland Europe, the UK and Ireland. Through our constant commitment to ownership, learning, and care, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner within the European logistics space. Our vision is to become the leading pan-European specialist logistics provider, with the most comprehensive end-to-end solutions.



Key responsibilities:

    RFQ data preparation: You drive crucial analyses and extract valuable insights based on customer data and requirements, used to make tangible commercial decisions, impacting the growth and profitability of the entire group, at the same time, ensuring that our customer-centric approach remains at the forefront of our business strategy.
    Profitability simulations: You act as the conduit between operations, sales and senior management by facilitating business discussions and decisions on revenue/cost through flexible simulation models you will be building.
    Market intelligence: You are at the forefront of logistics innovations, customer wishes and competitive dynamics through collecting micro- and macro-economical insights on the market internally and externally.





Your skills and qualifications:

    Minimum: a bachelor’s degree in economics, statistics, mathematics, industrial engineering, or any other quantitative relevant field.
    Affinity for data analysis.
    Advanced MS Excel proficiency and modelling:

    Mastery of complex formulas, pivot tables, and data visualization.
    Ability to create and maintain data models for in-depth analysis.

    Macro- & micro-economic trends analysis and market research data collection:

    Understanding of macroeconomic trends affecting the logistics industry.
    Ability to analyse and interpret economic indicators, conduct interviews and other data collection methods to extract insights from the wider business (e.g. Sales, IT, Strategy, etc.).

    Strong communication skills in English (spoken and written).
    Problem-solving skills.
    The ability to plan and work independently towards set goals.





Qualifications that are desirable:

    Previous experience in data analysis of large datasets and in pricing

    Proven experience in RFQ (Request for Quotation) data analysis
    Ability to conduct pricing, cost and profitability flexible simulations based on various factors.

    Familiarity with advanced analytics tools and techniques (e.g., AI-driven pricing, machine learning, predictive modelling) for enhancing pricing strategies.
    Master’s degree in relevant area.
    Strong communication skills in one of the Nordic languages (spoken and written).





What we offer:

We offer you a familiar workplace where you become an essential part of our company. In our opinion, success is created through flexibility, good cooperation and commitment, where participation, responsiveness and the chance to influence drive us forward. We work in an open, positive, and inspiring environment with passionate colleagues who enjoy having fun at work. Something we are convinced benefits both profitability and ensures satisfied employees. We therefore organize kick-offs, Christmas dinners, and after-work events.  Additionally, every month, we recognize outstanding achievements by crowning the Employee of the Month, as nominated by colleagues.



We have breakfast at all our locations in Sweden so that we can have a good start to the day together. We believe that an active life creates productivity and therefore encourage the use of the wellness allowance. We conduct exchanges between our locations and roles to create understanding, camaraderie, and educational opportunities. With us, there are great opportunities to grow and develop in the long run, where you set the limit for how far your ambitions can take you!







Practical information:

    Start: The start date for the role is as soon as possible
    Employment contract: Permanent with initial probationary period
    Extent: Full-time.
    Location: Månskärsvägen 5, 141 75 Kungens Kurva.
    Recruiting process: We use competency-based interviews where your skills, knowledge and qualities relevant to DANX and the role will be assessed. After that, we carry out logical and personal tests that we go through together to build an even clearer picture of you as a candidate. We also do a background check on final candidate, as part of the process.
    Application: If the position sounds interesting, send in your application today. Selection is being made on a running basis.
    Contact: If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact our manager Leonel at mailto:leonel.andersson@danx.se or our HR department at mailto:HR@danx.se Please note that in line with GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.





Please note that the recruitment process may take longer than usual due to summer vacations.



We are processing this recruitment ourselves and do not wish for recruitment firms to contact us regarding this recruitment - nor interim consultancy firms. Thank you.

jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
jobs.description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Ohjaajia sijaisuuksiin Kontukodeille
jobs.description:
Tule Kontukodin asukkaille ohjaajaksi ja meille työkaveriksi!

Etsimme lähihoitajia ja lähihoitajaopiskelijoita eri pituisiin sijaisuuksiin Kontukodeille, ympärivuorokautisen ikäihmisten palveluasumisen Kontu Satamaan, Kontu Toukolaan ja Kontu Pyynikille, sekä yhteisöllisen palveluasumisen Kontu Hopeakallioon.

Toimintamme lähtökohtana ovat asukkaiden omien voimavarojen tukeminen ja elämisen arvoinen elämä. Meille tärkeintä on asukkaidemme oman näköinen ja mielekäs elämä kodissa, jossa jokainen viihtyy ja tuntee olevansa arvostettu.

Mikäli sinulla on lähihoitajan tutkinto, tartuntatautilain mukainen rokotussuoja, sekä hygieniapassi ja olet kiinnostunut tehtävästä lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ja CV rekry@kontukoti.fi 23.8.26 mennessä. Eduksi katsotaan kokemus iäkkäiden kanssa toimimisesta ja psykogeriatrinen osaaminen. Opiskelijoita edellytämme, että lääkehoidon opinnot ovat suoritettu. Pyydämme esittämään tarvittaessa rikosrekisteriotteen iäkkäiden kanssa toimimiseen ennen sijaisuuden alkua. Työ on 2-tai 3-vuorotyötä. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Lisätietoja saat: Laatujohtaja Minna Hietanen, p.**050 501 3498.**

Miksi liittyä Konnun väkeen? Toimintamme on suunnitelmallista ja takana on harkittu ajatus. Työnantajana olemme joustavia ja meillä voit mm. olla mukana suunnittelemassa työvuorojasi. Meille on tärkeää, että saat hyvän perehdytyksen työhösi ja voit kehittyä ammatillisesti.

Rakennamme Kontua yhdessä! Myönteinen asenne, avoin mieli ja halu olla mukana luomassa houkuttelevaa hoiva-alaa. Konnussa arvostamme monimuotoisuutta, tasa-arvoa ja yhdenvertaisuutta. Panostamme henkilöstön hyvinvointiin, sillä hyvinvoiva väki on edellytys toiminnalle. Olemme määritelleet yhteisen hyvän tavan toimia ja arvojamme ovatkin: Elämä, väki ja avoimuus. Yhteisössämme uusia asukkaiden tarinoita kirjoitetaan yhdessä tervetuloa osaksi Konnun väkeä!

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Hyvin toimivan, inhimillisen toimintamallin, joka tuottaa hyviä kokemuksia.

- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan (lähihoitaja G20).

- Palkitsemismallit, jotka perustuvat niin henkilökohtaiseen tekemiseen, kuin yrityksen menestykseen.

- Reilusti Epassi-saldoa

- Työterveyshuollon Lääkärikeskus Medisportissa.

- Henkilöstöetuna Kontukotien oman jalkahoitajan jalkahoidot.

- Lomarahat jo kesäkuussa.

- Ruokailuetu omissa Kontukeittiöiden lounasravintoloissamme (-50 % alennus).

- Koulutuksia oman mielenkiintosi ja yrityksen tavoitteiden mukaisesti.

- Reilun virkistysbudjetin yhteisen vapaa-ajantoiminnan järjestämiseksi.

- Yhteisöllisen työvuorosuunnittelun ilman kellokorttia!

jobs.title: Senior Neurophysiologist
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
AMS Diagnostics is recruiting a senior Neurophysiologist to run its outpatient neurophysiology lab in Cork City, Ireland. The service is providing Nerve Conduction Studies (NCS) to patients that are referred for this investigation. The company is planning on introducing Electroencephalograms (EEG’s) and Home Video Telemetry (HVT) EEG’s in the short future. The Neurophysiologist will work closely with the Consultant Neurophysiologist to advance knowledge in the field and improve patient outcomes. The Neurophysiologist will perform duties and responsibilities according to the philosophy of AMS Diagnostics, including excellent patient care and swift access to services for our referring physicians. Patient care, teamwork & customer service are key priorities in this role. Key Responsibilities Triage referrals received and discuss them with Consultant Clinical Neurophysiologist when required. Go through patient questionnaire & relevant history with the patient prior to performing the test. Thoroughly understands various disease states and factors that relate to them, various medication effects, clinical changes or complications to ensure high technical quality of the study performed. Performs high-quality nerve conduction studies & EEG’s autonomously and according to protocols. Produces a high-quality factual report for the Consultant Neurophysiologist to interpret and report on the studies performed. Includes notes on the study where relevant. Obtains standard recordings, utilises judgement to determine whether patient meets normal standards and reports significant changes to appropriate personnel. Performs calibration as required and ensures maintenance as appropriate. Able to troubleshoot minor equipment issues and escalate necessary Keep documentation in line with the clinic’s protocols Adhere to GDPR principles at all times Be confident in training and supervising new Physiologists/students in Neurophysiology studies carried out at the Diagnostic Centre. Open and willing to develop new applicable services within the organisation. During quiet periods be willing and able to perform other functions e.g. contact referred patients to make appointments. Show and explain to patients how to wear other at home diagnostic devices such as Holter /Sleep equipment. Qualifications: Possess the BSc in Clinical Measurement from Dublin Institute of Technology or from a recognised equivalent 3rd level institution. Minimum of 3 years post-graduation experience in Neurophysiology and in performing nerve conduction studies & EEG’s autonomously. High Proficiency in English (speaking & writing). This job description is not exhaustive it indicates the main responsibilities of the post and is subject to periodic revision and amendment with the post holder.

jobs.title: Kodinkoneasentaja
jobs.description:
Avantego Oy on vakavarainen ja luotettava työnantaja. Historiamme kodinkoneiden kuljetus- ja asennuspalveluista ulottuu 2000-luvun alkuun, jolloin nykyinen operatiivinen johto on aloittanut kodinkoneiden kuljetus- ja asennustyöt Tampereella ja Hämeenlinnassa. Kuljetimme ja asensimme noin 25000 kodinkonetta vuonna 2025. Työllistämme kumppanimme mukaan lukien noin 45 työntekijää. Kuluvana vuonna kuljettamiemme ja asentamiemme kodinkoneiden määrä kasvaa noin 40 000 kodinkoneeseen. Vuodesta 2024 olemme toimineet KOTIISI -Kerralla kuntoon brändillä.

Kodinkoneiden kuljetus- ja asennusliiketoimintamme edelleen laajentuessa haemme palvelukseen KODINKONEASENTAJAA Satakuntaan, Porin ja Rauman seudulle.

Työtä tehdään omatoimisesti tai pareittain asiakkaiden luona ja työhön kuuluu kodinkoneiden kuljetus- ja asennustehtäviä.

Työssä menestyminen vaatii hyvää peruskuntoa, reipasta ja iloista otetta työhön sekä vähintään B-luokan ajo-oikeutta. Koulutus ja kokemus lvi- tai/ja sähköalalta katsotaan eduksi, sillä toimitamme mm. astianpesukoneita ja kotitalousliesiä asennettuna.

Aiempaa kokemusta kodinkoneiden asentamisesta olisi hyvä olla jo kartutettuna. Työhön opastus ja käyttämiemme järjestelmien koulutus kuuluu aina työnaloitus perehdytykseen. Sujuva Suomen kielen taito on välttämätön ja muu kielitaito (englanti, ruotsi) on plussaa.

Vapaamuotoiset hakemukset palkkatoiveineen pyydämme lähettämään sähköpostilla, rekrytointi@kotiisi.net.

Nyt tarjottava tehtävä sisältää pääasiassa työtä auton apumiehenä / toisena asentajana. Työ on luonteeltaan sellaista, että jokaiselle päivälle ei välttämättä ole tunteja tarjolla. Työpäivät sekä työpäivien pituus voidaan sovittaa valittavan tekijän oman elämäntilanteen mukaan. Työ sopii hyvin esim. opiskelijalle tai lisätyöksi epäsäännöllistä työtä tekevälle.

Maskinoperatør / Produktionsmedarbejder til vores fabrik i Roust

Vil du have et job med gode fremtidsmuligheder, stærkt fællesskab og adgang til moderne maskiner og udstyr? Hos os får du en aktiv hverdag, hvor du kan udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt – og hvor sikkerhed og ordentlighed er en del af kulturen.

Du tilbydes

  • Et spændende job med gode udviklingsmuligheder
  • En aktiv hverdag med engagerede kollegaer og stærk holdånd
  • Personlig og faglig udvikling – bl.a. gennem videreuddannelse
  • En kultur præget af respekt, rettidig omhu og en uformel omgangstone
  • Fast stilling på timeløn og skiftehold (dag/aften/nat)
  • God løn, pension og sundhedsordning
  • Arbejdstøj og vask heraf, senest efter 4 ugers ansættelse

Dine opgaver

  • Du bliver en vigtig del af produktionen, hvor du sammen med dit team sikrer høj kvalitet og stabil drift
  • Betjening af belægningsstensmaskine
  • Truckkørsel (4-gaflet truck)
  • Kvalitetskontrol
  • Rengøring af betonblander og siloer samt oprydning i produktionen

Vi søger dig, som…

  • Har erfaring fra produktion og hænderne godt skruet på
  • Trives med fysisk arbejde
  • Er selvkørende og ikke bange for at tage fat
  • Besidder teknisk forståelse
  • Har viljen og lysten til at lære nyt
  • Er let omgængelig, pålidelig og mødestabil
  • Tager medansvar og bidrager til den gode stemning
  • Har truckcertifikat og kørekort B
  • Kan fremvise ren straffeattest

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en del af CRH – en international koncern – men i Roust er vi et lokalt team med stærkt sammenhold, uformel tone og fokus på sikkerhed. Vi hjælper hinanden, vi udvikler hinanden, og vi får tingene gjort.

Klar til at blive en del af holdet i Roust

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag. Vi holder samtaler løbende, indtil vi har fundet den rette.

Om CRH Products

CRH Products har ca. 150 medarbejdere på seks lokationer i Danmark og leverer alt fra fliser, belægning og støttemure til rør- og brøndsystemer, bygværker og plansiloer. Vi er en del af CRH i Danmark, der samlet har ca. 1.500 ansatte på 19 lokationer inden for råhusbyggeri, råstoffer, belægning og rørsystemer. Vores mål er at udvikle løsninger, der bygger, forbinder og forbedrer verden.

Læs mere på www.crhproducts.dk.

Työ sisältää avustamista työnantajan päivittäisissä toiminnoissa, kodinhoidollisia toimia (pyykinpesu, siivous yms.), ruuanlaittoa, asioiden hoitamista puhelimitse, avustamista koiran ja kissojen hoidossa sekä koulutuksessa (ruokinta, kynsienleikkuu, kissanvessojen siivous, harjaus, lääkkeiden anto ym.)

Tämän lisäksi työnantaja tarvitsee kodin ulkopuolella apua kaikissa toimissa.

Työtunteja on tavallisesti n. 50h/kk, mutta syyskuussa tunteja tulee enemmän. Työ on vuorotyötä, jossa on aamu- ja iltavuoroja arkisin sekä viikonloppuisin. Toisinaan vuorot voivat olla myös pitkiä (10-11h pituisia).

Työnantaja toivoo oma-aloitteista, rauhallista, hyväkuntoista ja varmaotteista avustajaa. Avustajalla tulisi olla maalaisjärkeä, tilannetajua, huumoria, ajokortti, sekä suomen kieli äidinkielenä. Työnantajan kodin läheisyyteen ei kulje julkinen liikenne.

Pääasiassa uusiin työsuhteisiin kuuluu koeaika.

Katso tarkemmat hakuohjeet sivun alalaidasta.

Lounais-Suomen Avustajakeskus/LSLY ry (avustajakeskus.fi) välittää henkilökohtaisia avustajia vammaisille työnantajille. Avustajan valinnasta päättää työnantaja itse.

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher, Strategic Business Development (H2Nexus Project)
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University of Vaasa is seeking a motivated and talented Doctoral Researcher to join the Research Council of Finland-funded H2NEXUS project.

The position is full-time and fixed-term (3 years), aligned with the duration of the H2NEXUS project. The preferred start date is September 2026 or as agreed. The position is located in the [School of Management](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/university/organisation-and-management/school-management) in the [Strategic Business Development](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/groups-and-focus-areas/strategic-business-development)research grouphttps://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/groups/public-policy-and-governance. The position is located in Vaasa.

About the Project

The H2Nexus project investigates the co-evolution of markets and energy ecosystems, with a particular focus on the emergence of the hydrogen economy in Finland. The project enables a comprehensive understanding of the systemic change through a dual approach: combining techno-economic modelling with a theoretical lens that views markets as designed and evolving coordination systems.

The project explores how institutional work and market practices shape the development and stabilization of key components such as business model innovation, pricing mechanisms, and ecosystem governance. A central research objective is to analyze the conditions and mechanisms that enable or hinder the transition from early-stage development to more mature and institutionalized stages.

Quantitative and qualitative analyses will be integrated into this research, particularly to analyze the impacts of new hydrogen markets and regulations on both the overall energy system and business cases in some hard-to-abate sectors, such as the production of steel, fertilizers, shipping fuels, and aviation fuels. The research will incorporate project-level and system-level models for hydrogen and its derivatives, aligned with market-shaping theory.

The project will produce new knowledge on the clean hydrogen market from market-ecosystem, business case, and energy system perspectives, as well as relevant new datasets, modelling methods, and blueprints. The results can be directly utilized in the scientific community, but also to improve decision-making in the public and private sectors.

Your Role

You will play a key role in the project team and actively participate in the implementation of different activities within the research project. The role emphasizes the ability to conduct high-quality research and interact with different national and international stakeholders. Your work will contribute directly to project deliverables and high-quality academic publications.

Key Responsibilities in the position:

- Contribute to the projects activities.
- Conduct independent and collaborative research on ecosystem emergence, market shaping, and business model innovation.
- Collaborate with an interdisciplinary group of universities, research organisations, manufacturers, retailers, and civil society organisations.
- Participate in data collection (e.g., interviews, workshops, case studies), analysis, and validation activities with industry stakeholders and policy makers.
- Lead and co-author high-quality scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
- Support teaching or supervision tasks when applicable (according to university guidelines).
- Present research at academic conferences and project meetings.
- Produce a doctoral dissertation based on the research carried out within the project.

The position may also include other tasks to be agreed upon separately. All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

A person who has completed a suitable higher university degree (see below) and is a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa can be selected for the position of Doctoral Researcher. We therefore expect the selected person to have the ability and motivation for doctoral studies and to complete a doctoral degree. The selected candidate needs to apply for doctoral studies through a separate application to the University of Vaasa's Graduate School | [Read more about doctoral education, application and eligibility for studies.](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Required:

- Masters degree in a relevant field of business studies, such as management, industrial management, B2B management, or a related field.
- Strong proven interest in the research area of the project.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent communication skills in English.
- Motivation to produce high-quality research outputs.

Desirable:

- Experience with qualitative or mixed methods research.
- Experience working with industry stakeholders.
- Experience related to the project's context, whether it be energy or even hydrogen.

Read more about the selection process and language policies: [University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/open-positions/application-and-selection-process)

We offer

- A fully funded doctoral researcher position (3 years) aligned with a high-profile Research Council of Finland project.
- The selected applicant will be accepted into the University of Vaasas Doctoral Programme and will pursue their doctoral degree in Management after a separate application process.
- Opportunity to collaborate with leading experts across Europe.
- Training in doctoral research, methods, and professional skills.
- Access to industry cases, real-world data, and hands-on circular innovation activities.
- Supportive research environment within the University of Vaasas vibrant research community.

We promote the overall well-being of our employees at work by, among other things, offering fitness and cultural benefits, extensive occupational health care services, and versatile opportunities for continuous learning. F

jobs.title: Lastenhoitaja tueksi lapsiperheille
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien lapsiperheiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten sote-alan opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai sote-alan koulutuksen omaava konkari, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme, isäämme, ystäväämme tai lastamme.

Mikä on helpperi?

Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle avustettavalle henkilölle, kuten lapselle. Helpperi tukee asiakasta kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, päivittäisissä toimissa, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain seurana ollessa ja huolehtien. Ajan myötä helpperistä, asiakkaasta ja hänen perheestään voi tulla läheisiä keskenään.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Etsimme tiimiimme sote-alan koulutettuja hoitajia auttamaan lapsiperheitä

Asiakkaisiimme kuuluu niin lapsia kuin lapsiperheitä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset tukemaan lapsiperheitä heidän hektisessä ja kiireisessä elämäntilanteessa tarjoamalla arvokasta aikaasi lapsiperheen arjen pyörittämiseen. Tehtävät voivat liittyä lapsien kanssa leikkimiseen ja ulkoiluun aina kodinhoidollisiin askareisiin, kuten roskien viemiseen. Välillä käynnit voivat sujua ihan vain yhdessä puuhaillen vaikkapa värityskirjan äärellä.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Helppereitämme yhdistää halu viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa. Tässä työssä pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, että asiakkaidemme arki olisi parempaa ja helpompaa. Annamme lisäpisteitä, jos sinulta löytyy kokemusta lapsiperheiden kanssa työskentelystä!

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat: "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen asiakkaan kanssa." "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne." "Helppyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."

Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 14.82-16.03 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Ready to take ownership of the German market? Stock Group A/S is looking for a Key Account Manager.
jobs.description:
About this role

Stock Group is a Danish FMCG distributor with a growing portfolio of celebrity chef brands across Northern Europe. We are expanding into Germany and are looking for a Key Account Manager to build and own our commercial presence in the market.

Our flagship brand in Germany is a product line developed, owned and distributed by Stock Group — built around one of Germany's most recognised celebrity chef profiles. The brand has strong TV heritage, wide consumer recognition, and a product range that speaks directly to the everyday home cook. Full brand details are shared with candidates during the interview process.

You will be based at our headquarters in Vejle, Denmark, with regular travel to Germany. We are open to candidates based in Germany if the profile is right, but our strong preference is for someone based in Vejle with experience managing international markets from Denmark.

Reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you will work closely with a tight-knit KAM team that has built this model from the ground up.

What you will be doing

  • Building and managing key account relationships with retail chains, grocery buyers, and trade partners in Germany

  • Driving sell-in of our brand portfolio — presenting ranges, negotiating listings, and following up on performance

  • Planning and executing in-store activations, promotions, and trade marketing initiatives

  • Tracking market dynamics, competitor activity, and customer needs — feeding insights back to the team in Vejle

  • Travelling regularly to Germany to meet buyers, visit stores, and attend relevant trade events

  • Working closely with colleagues across sales, marketing, and supply chain in Denmark

The brands you will work with

In Germany, you will be selling a Stock Group brand built around a leading celebrity chef — one of the strongest commercial chef profiles in the German-speaking market. The product range covers cookware, knives, and kitchen essentials with proven consumer appeal. Further details are shared confidentially during the hiring process.

Our chef brands are built on strong TV personalities, high consumer recognition, and product ranges covering hybrid cookware, knives, airfryers, kitchen appliances and accessories. Your job is to get them listed, activated, and selling.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a commercially driven KAM with genuine FMCG experience — someone who knows how to open doors, build relationships with buyers, and drive sell-through on the shelf.

  • FMCG/retail experience. You have worked in sales, KAM, or trade marketing — ideally with exposure to grocery, electronics retail, or housewares.

  • Strong communicator. You are confident presenting to buyers, negotiating terms, and building rapport at all levels of a retail organisation.

  • Self-starter. You take ownership of your market without needing daily supervision — but you know when to bring the team in.

  • Language skills. English. Germany language skills are a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable with travel. The role involves regular visits to Germany to meet buyers, visit stores, and attend relevant trade events.

A brand with proven demand — before you walk in the door

Behind every brand in our portfolio sits Stock Group's full commercial engine — product development, logistics, content production, and dedicated direct-to-consumer ecom shops running in each chef's name across our active markets.

While our German ecom presence is in preparation, we enter the market fully ready: a complete product range, professional content and marketing assets, and documented consumer and sales data from our established markets that removes the guesswork from day one.

You will not be pioneering in the dark. You will be bringing a model that already works — into one of Europe's largest retail markets.

What we offer

  • A strong and growing portfolio of celebrity chef brands with genuine consumer pull

  • A Denmark-based role — work from our Vejle HQ with a team that has three years of market experience to draw on

  • Full support from marketing, supply chain, and finance — you sell, we back you up

  • Real ownership of your market from day one

  • Competitive salary, travel budget, and benefits package

 

How to apply

Send your CV and a brief cover note. Tell us why you are the right person to build our presence in Germany. For questions, contact Head of Sales Steffan Voss at: steffan@stockgroup.dk or +45 81 37 67 47

We review applications on a rolling basis — don't wait.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer to Verified (AML)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced fullstack engineer who wants to build modern, cloud-based systems that help combat financial crime? This role offers the opportunity to work across the full stack, influence architecture, and collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions within the Anti-Money Laundering domain in a fast-moving RegTech environment.

About Verified Verified started with solutions for electronic signing, identity verification, and contract management. In close collaboration with its customers, the company has since evolved into a RegTech provider of digital workflows for Anti-Money Laundering and supplier due diligence.

The platform is API-first and delivered as SaaS and PaaS, built for secure and scalable cloud-based services across electronic signing, electronic identification and AML capabilities. An “AI-first” approach is also being adopted, with AI agents and services integrated both internally and into customer-facing products.

The team consists of dedicated colleagues across the Nordics and Europe and the company culture is built on shared ownership, where all employees contribute to building the future of Verified and take responsibility for what is promised and delivered, both internally and in customer collaborations. These values have been central to the company’s journey so far and will continue to be important as it grows and aims for even higher goals.

About the role and the team As a Senior Fullstack Engineer in the AML domain, you will play a key role in building and evolving Verified’s cloud platform for secure and scalable trust services. You will work across both frontend and backend services running in AWS, contributing to systems that support critical compliance workflows.

You will join a high-autonomy, cross-functional team where ownership is shared and the full lifecycle of core services is handled collectively. The team is responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating services end-to-end, with a strong focus on scalability, security, and time-to-market.

Working in an agile environment, you will collaborate closely with product owners, designers, QA, and other engineers to deliver robust and high-quality solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based systems in AWS

    

Build and evolve REST APIs and modern web applications

    

Contribute to architecture and technical decisions

    

Improve scalability by decoupling dependencies and reducing time-to-market

    

Integrate AI capabilities such as AI agents and RAG into products and workflows

    

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues

    

Drive engineering quality through code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and best practices

    

Contribute to continuous improvement in architecture and engineering practices

About you We believe you are a self-driven fullstack engineer who thrives in high-autonomy environments where you take end-to-end ownership of complex systems. You are comfortable working across the stack in modern cloud-based SaaS products and enjoy building scalable and secure solutions with real business impact.

You are curious about how modern technologies, including AI, can be applied both in products and across the development lifecycle. You are comfortable working with technical trade-offs and contributing to improvements in system design, performance, and developer experience.

To succeed in this role, we believe you likely bring:

    

10+ years of experience as a Fullstack Engineer in cloud-based SaaS environments

    

Strong experience working with Node.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue.js

    

Experience building REST APIs and API-first or distributed systems

    

Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS

    

Good understanding of system design, security, and modern application architecture

    

Experience or interest in working with AI tools in development workflows

    

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

It is a plus if you also have experience from FinTech/RegTech or other regulated environments, as well as experience integrating third-party data sources.

Pracitical Information

Start: According to the agreement

Extent: Full-time

Location: Solna

We look forward to receiving your application! Do you think this role could be a good fit for you, or perhaps someone you know? We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the final application deadline, so don’t hesitate - submit your application today.

The recruitment process is handled by Ed:Za Group. If you have any questions or concerns regarding the role or the process, you are warmly welcome to contact us.

jobs.description:
Har du solid erfaring med truckkørsel, og trives du med lagerarbejde, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus? Så er det måske dig vi søger

På vegne af vores kunde DACS søger vi en lagermedarbejder til en Try & Hire-stilling.

Du bliver en del af et mindre og erfarent lagerteam bestående af tre kolleger, hvor samarbejde, hjælpsomhed og kvalitet er en naturlig del af hverdagen.   • Har truckcertifikat og solid praktisk erfaring med truckkørsel.

Har ovenstående fanget din interesse, søger du stillingen ved at vedhæfte et opdateret cv og en motiveret ansøgning. Du kan også skrive en kort tekst om dig selv i ansøgningsteksten ovenfor. Temp-Team A/S varetager denne rekruttering og al henvendelse skal gå gennem Temp-Team.

jobs.title: Tiler
jobs.description:
The duties of a waterproofer and tiler include a wide range of wet-room and tiling work in both new-build and renovation projects. Work areas include bathrooms, toilets, saunas, utility rooms, kitchens, and other interior and exterior spaces requiring tiling.

The duties include:

- Reviewing construction drawings and work instructions

- Protecting the work area and inspecting the condition of the substrate

- Removing old tiles, waterproofing membranes, and other surface materials when necessary

- Cleaning, sanding, levelling, and straightening wall and floor surfaces

- Checking floor slopes and correcting them when necessary

- Applying primers and preparing surfaces

- Waterproofing wet rooms in accordance with the system manufacturers instructions

- Carefully sealing corners, penetrations, joints, and floor drains

- Measuring, planning, setting out, and installing wall and floor tiles

- Cutting, drilling, and fitting tiles

- Preparing and applying tile adhesive

- Grouting tiled surfaces and applying silicone sealant

- Epoxy grouting and other specialist grouting when required

- Cleaning, finishing, and protecting completed surfaces


The work involves handling various types of tiles, including ceramic tiles, clinker tiles, mosaics, and natural-stone tiles. The employee must be able to use the materials, machinery, tools, and equipment required for waterproofing and tiling work.

jobs.title: Job i Malaga - Technical Support Advisor for Phillips til vores danske team i Benalmádena - Opstart i august
jobs.description:
Technical Support Advisor for Phillips til vores danske team i Benalmádena.

Alle kan søge, men vi foretrækker en fastboende i Málaga‑regionen, da opstart er hurtigst mulig.

Hvad skal jeg lave?

Dette er en teknisk kundeservicerolle, hvor du hjælper dansktalende brugere af Philips TV og audiovisuelle produkter. Du arbejder med kunder, der oplever problemer med deres TV‑opsætning, forbindelser, lyd eller billede, smart‑TV apps eller generel brug af udstyret. Din opgave er at guide dem igennem fejlsøgningen trin for trin, uanset om det handler om Wi‑Fi, HDMI, softwareopdateringer eller kompatibilitet mellem enheder. Når en sag er mere kompleks, sørger du for at sende den videre til de tekniske specialister. Rollen handler i høj grad om at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og levere support af høj kvalitet i et miljø, hvor KPI’er og kundetilfredshed er centrale.

Kort sagt er du den person, kunderne kontakter, når deres TV ikke fungerer, og du hjælper dem med at finde løsningen – enten ved at løse problemet direkte eller ved at guide dem videre.

TP Vision er virksomheden bag Philips TV og audio globalt. De udvikler, producerer og markedsfører Philips‑brandede TV og lydprodukter i Europa, Latinamerika og flere andre regioner. Virksomheden er en del af TPV Technology, som er en af verdens største producenter af monitorer og TV‑paneler. TP Vision har hovedkontor i Amsterdam og opererer internationalt inden for forbrugerelektronik. Kort fortalt er det TP Vision, der driver og udvikler Philips TV‑forretningen på verdensplan.

Rollen er attraktiv, fordi du får mulighed for at arbejde med et globalt elektronikbrand og samtidig få en stærk indgang til teknisk support, IT og AV‑relaterede roller. Du bliver en del af et struktureret arbejdsmiljø med klare KPI’er og gode udviklingsmuligheder – og du arbejder i Benalmádena på Costa del Sol.

Hvordan er kontormiljøet?

Du bliver en del af et internationalt team med dansk‑ og engelsktalende kolleger. Kontoret ligger ved Málaga og har moderne faciliteter, professionelle arbejdsstationer og et stærkt socialt miljø. Der er fokus på samarbejde, udvikling og trivsel, og du får mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med både danske og internationale medarbejdere.

Dit ansvar:

  • Yder 1st level IT‑support via telefon, mail og chat og hjælper brugerne videre, når de oplever tekniske udfordringer

  • Hjælper medarbejdere med at navigere i systemer, programmer og hardware

  • Arbejder med fejlsøgning og identificerer årsagerne til tekniske problemer

  • Håndterer IT‑tickets og sikrer, at sagerne bliver prioriteret korrekt

  • Benytter interne vidensdatabaser til at finde løsninger hurtigt og effektivt

  • Indgår i tæt samarbejde med 2nd level‑teams og eksterne leverandører

  • Bidrager til en professionel og serviceminded oplevelse for alle brugere

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk i både skrift og tale og kommunikerer sikkert på engelsk (C1)

  • Har interesse for IT og gerne erfaring med supportopgaver

  • Kender til Windows 10, Office 365 og MS Teams og føler dig hjemme i digitale miljøer

  • Arbejder struktureret og kan holde overblik, selv når der er flere opgaver i gang

  • Trives i en rolle, hvor service, hjælpsomhed og tydelig kommunikation er i fokus

  • Har en analytisk tilgang og kan løse tekniske udfordringer på en systematisk måde

  • Er nysgerrig, lærevillig og motiveret for at arbejde i et internationalt team

Løn og benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidskontrakt (indefinido) med spansk kontraktsret

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn på 2071 Euro/ Brutto

  • Bonusordning på op til 1800 Euro om året /Brutto

  • Spansk social sikring, pension og betalt ferie

  • Mulighed for delvist hjemmearbejde efter oplæring

  • Moderne kontormiljø i solrige omgivelser

  • Flyttehjælp og assistance med lokale formaliteter

Den perfekte kandidat:

Den ideelle kandidat til denne rolle er en person, der trives i et miljø, hvor service, problemløsning og kommunikation går hånd i hånd. Du er typen, der bliver nysgerrig, når noget ikke virker, og som gerne vil forstå, hvad der ligger bag en teknisk udfordring. Samtidig er du god til mennesker og formår at skabe ro og tryghed, når du hjælper andre gennem en IT‑udfordring. Du arbejder struktureret, holder hovedet koldt, når der er flere opgaver i spil, og du har en naturlig lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dine kompetencer. Det er vigtigt, at du er samarbejdsorienteret og trives i et internationalt miljø, hvor man hjælper hinanden og deler viden. Hvis du både kan lide at arbejde med mennesker og teknologi, og du motiveres af at gøre en forskel for brugerne, vil du passe perfekt ind i teamet.

Hvad får du ud af at tage arbejde hos virksomheden?

  • Solrigt klima, lavere leveomkostninger og afslappet livsstil

  • Arbejdsdage der slutter tidligt og lang weekend hver uge

  • Mulighed for at netværke med internationale kolleger

  • Kombination af professionel vækst og personlig trivsel

  • Et stærkt fællesskab i et moderne, åbent kontormiljø med fokus på diversitet

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Senior Project Manager acts as a proxy Product Manager supporting Agile delivery by managing the product backlog and working closely with squad teams. Translates business and technical requirements into clear specifications and compliant documentation performs impact and feasibility assessments supports testing and releases and ensures audit ready documentation within regulated GxP environments using the Veeva Quality Vault platform.

Responsibilities

1. Work as a proxy Product Manager and responsibility for managing the product backlog and SQUAD

2. Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into clear structured specifications user stories or functional documentation to support solution delivery.

3. Perform impact and feasibility assessments for system changes identifying risks dependencies and potential impacts on existing processes or data.

4. Support Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement sprint planning and close collaboration with development and testing teams.

5. Act as a bridge between business and technical teams clarifying requirements resolving ambiguities and supporting informed decision making.

6. Support validation testing and release activities including UAT coordination defect analysis and confirmation that delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.

7. Create maintain update and approve technical and process documentation including: System Access Plan System Overview Process Flows Security Matrix Validation Report DTRA Responsible AI etc.

8. Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders (business IT compliance quality) to gather inputs validate content and incorporate feedback into documentation.

9. Ensure documentation readiness for audits and compliance reviews including traceability completeness and alignment with applicable standards and governance requirements.

10. Support continuous improvement of documentation practices identifying gaps redundancies or inconsistencies and proposing enhancements to structure and usability.



Key requirements

1. Veeva White Belt active certification is required

2. Proven experience in creating and maintaining technical documentation

3. Strong ability to collaborate with cross functional stakeholders in English

3. High attention to detail and quality

4. Experience working in regulated GxP environment
