jobs.title: SMB Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a marketing professional who combines strategy and execution, owning demand gen programs and campaigns for the SMB sales segment and startups in Japan. You will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including the Japan sales org, Japan and global marketing teams, and external agencies—to plan and deliver programs that drive results.

In addition, this role supports growth of Notion’s startup program by building awareness and driving trial acquisition, partnering with the Global/APAC startup team to execute marketing activities and recruit partners.

You may also support other marketing initiatives to unlock the full potential of the business in Japan.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Develop a strong understanding of the Notion product and the SMB user/buyer journey to identify the highest-impact plays for the segment. Partner with SMB Sales leadership to set program priorities, define target audiences and goals, and align on campaign plans—proactively communicating progress, results, and learnings to stakeholders.

 - Own end-to-end execution of events and webinars—from planning and logistics through day-of delivery and post-event lead management—translating the agreed program plan into flawless execution. Partner closely with SDRs to ensure timely follow-up, clean lead handoffs, and maximum pipeline impact.

 - Execute demand gen campaigns in our marketing automation platform (e.g., nurture/engagement programs), including audience/segmentation setup and campaign builds, in coordination with Japan + global marketing teams on content and messaging (e.g., gated offers).

 - Partner with APAC Marketing Ops and BizTech to keep GTM systems running smoothly (marketing automation platform, Salesforce, Outreach, Sansan)—including intake/ticketing, operational processes, and system governance (e.g., lead scoring changes, integrations, and best practices).

 - Own lead and pipeline reporting for the SMB segment, tracking key KPIs and regularly assessing pipeline health to inform optimizations across programs.

 - Increase awareness of the Notion for Startups program among early-stage startups and drive acquisition of startup trials through localized, high-velocity campaigns.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5–7 years of experience managing and executing demand generation programs and campaigns for B2B companies.

 - Proven track record of hitting aggressive growth goals by leveraging campaigns such as email and webinars, with expertise in end-to-end campaign development, execution, and measurement.

 - Proficiency with marketing automation platforms, SFDC, Outreach, Sansan and Figma.

 - Customer-centric and insight-driven. You understand the customer journey and each influencer in the decision-making process, and you use customer insights to design campaigns.

 - Strong cross-functional relationship-building skills. You’ve worked closely with sales, content, SDRs and operations partners.

 - Experience planning and executing webinars from start to finish.

 - Previous experience working with global teams.

 - Proficient in fluent-level Japanese and business-level English, both written and verbal.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - A builder mindset




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Be a Notion power user and are already an advocate for the tool.

 - Track record of interacting with startup founders, VC firms, and incubators




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Data Engineer Kafka (H/F)
jobs.description:
Soors est une société de conseil spécialisée dans l'accompagnement des entreprises pour leurs projets IT et data. Nous proposons à nos clients des experts hautement qualifiés pour intervenir sur des missions stratégiques et innovantes, en France et à l'international. Notre positionnement est fondé sur la qualité, la transparence et la confiance, ainsi que sur la valorisation des talents. Nous attachons une grande importance au développement professionnel et personnel de nos consultants, en favorisant la montée en compétences, la collaboration et l'engagement. Rejoindre Soors, c'est intégrer un environnement stimulant, où l'innovation et l'excellence sont au coeur de notre culture.

Le poste :

Dans le cadre d'une mission longue durée, vous contribuerez à la transformation des architectures data d'un grand groupe en accélérant la transition vers une plateforme événementielle moderne.

Poste et missions :
- Mettre en place et configurer une plateforme Kafka en self-service pour le groupe.
- Développer et intégrer des pipelines CI/CD via GitLab.
- Implémenter des outils self-service à l'aide de Kafka Resource Operator (KRO).
- Rédiger la documentation, les guides de bonnes pratiques et les procédures d'exploitation.
- Assurer le support technique auprès des équipes consommatrices de la plateforme.

Responsabilités :
- Modernisation des flux ETL historiques vers une architecture cible.
- Garantir la qualité, la sécurité et l'automatisation de la plateforme.
- Collaboration avec les équipes internes pour la montée en compétence sur Kafka.

Environnement technique :
- Apache Kafka & Kafka Connect
- Kubernetes & Docker
- GitLab CI/CD
- Approche GitOps/Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- Outils de monitoring : Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry
- Data Platform : Data Lake, Data Mesh, Iceberg/Snowflake

Modalités :
- Mission de 12 mois
- Basée à Villeneuve-d'Ascq (59)
- Télétravail partiel possible

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons un Data Engineer confirmé disposant d'une expertise sur les plateformes Kafka et les architectures data modernes.

Expérience :
- Expérience significative sur Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect et leur écosystème.
- Pratique des environnements CI/CD, GitLab et méthodologies GitOps/IaC.

Formation :
- Formation supérieure en informatique ou data engineering (Bac+4/+5 recommandé).

Compétences techniques :
- Maîtrise de Kubernetes, Docker, monitoring (Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).
- Familiarité avec les concepts Data Platform (Data Lake, Data Mesh, Iceberg/Snowflake).
- Expérience avec KRO, FinOps et Cloud Providers est un plus.

Soft skills :
- Autonomie, rigueur, capacité d'adaptation et esprit d'équipe.
- Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles et pédagogiques.

Contraintes :
- Disponibilité pour une mission de longue durée (12 mois).
- Télétravail partiel possible.

jobs.title: Data Engineer H/F
jobs.description:
RESPONSABILITÉS :

Nous recherchons  un(e) data engineer capable de trouver des solutions innovantes et robustes à l'ensemble des problématiques Data.
Vous aurez la charge de :
- Participer à la conception et réalisation d'une solution Data depuis l'acquisition jusqu'à l'exploitation de la donnée en accompagnant la réflexion des directions métiers
- Identifier, collecter et intégrer les données nécessaires à la résolution de problématiques métier et opérationnelles
- Garantir la qualité des données en mettant en place les outils de mesure et de suivi adéquats en appliquant les règles de Data Gouvernance et de Data Management
- Transcrire des besoins métier en règles de gestion data
- Industrialiser le déploiement de vos réalisations à travers l'implémentation de tests unitaires, d'intégration et de non-régression

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

En tant que Data Engineer vous maîtrisez :
- Le langage SQL
- Un langage objet (Python, JAVA, Scala)
- Un framework de calcul distribué
- L'intégration continue (Git, JUnit, SonarQube, Jenkins)
- Un cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) ou une distribution Big Data (Hortonworks, Cloudera, Datastax)
- Les concepts de la modélisation relationnelle et non-relationnelle
Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une université, vous justifiez d'au minimum 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un contexte projet Data. Rigoureux(se), proactif(ve) et autonome vous restez en veille technologique et êtes force de proposition. Vous êtes capable de prendre de la hauteur et vous adapter aux enjeux du projet.

jobs.title: Job i Barcelona - Vil du videre fra Telemarketing og arbejde som Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?
jobs.description:
Vi søger en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist til vores internationale kontor i Barcelona. 

Har du arbejdet med salg eller Telemarketing i mere end et år, og er du klar til det næste skridt i den karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring og er du kreativ og vil gerne blive certificeret rådgiver der kan hjælpe andre med at lave succesfulde digitale kampagner? Hvis du er teknisk, kreativ og udadvendt og kan få tingene gjort i et tempofyldt, hurtigt skiftende miljø, har vi måske det perfekte job til dig!

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Dit ansvar:

  • Onboarding af kunder og opbygning af langsigtede relationer over telefon og videomøder

  • Udvikling af performance-drevne PPC-strategier

  • Proaktivt salg og kampagneoptimering

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kundedata

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Certificeringer og løbende kompetenceudvikling

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

Du kan også allerede nu booke en snak med os via dette link: Book et kald

jobs.title: KONOBAR/ICA
jobs.description: Café Allegri - SLOBOŠTINA Posjedujemo ugostiteljske objekte diljem Hrvatske, a koji su pozicionirani u sklopu supermarketa i radnim vremenom prilagođeni istima, te su ugodno i toplo uređeni. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste. Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj! Ako i nemate radnog iskustva te bi Vam ovo bilo prvo zaposlenje, rado ćemo Vas uzeti u obzir kao potencijalnog kandidata, te Vam pomoći u stjecanju iskustva i usvajanju novih znanja i vještina! Za dodatne informacije o našoj ponudi i uvjetima rada možete se javiti na broj 099 168 5677 ili posao@celka.hr. Naš tim proširujemo osobom koja ima želju za učenjem i kontinuiranim usavršavanjem na radnom mjestu: Ugostiteljski djelatnik (m/ž) Što ćete raditi? - posluživati goste sukladno propisanim pravilima i standardima - održavati čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i opreme - osiguravati primjenu propisanih i zadanih standarda u ugostiteljstvu - predstavljati organizaciju u najboljem svjetlu te izgrađivati prijateljske odnose sa gostima i kolegama Što nudimo? - stimulativne uvjete - rad u uspješnoj i stabilnoj tvrtki - dinamičnu i ugodnu radnu atmosferu

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: PEÓN SALA BLANCA EN INDUSTRIA CÁRNICA
jobs.description:
Funciones y tareas: * Deshuesado y preparación: Las piezas (previamente deshuesadas y limpias de corteza y grasa amarillenta) se preparan en mesas de trabajo dentro de la zona estéril. * Loncheado (corte): Se realiza a máquina o por cortadores profesionales que separan y combinan distintas partes de la pieza (maza, babilla, punta y jarrete) para obtener platos equilibrados en sabor y grasa infiltrada. También se lonchean aquí embutidos como lomo, salchichón o chorizo. * Envasado al vación o en atmósfera modificada: Las lonchas se distribuyen en bandejas o platos y se envasan inmediatamente al vacío o con una inyección de gas inerte para evitar la oxidación y extender su vida útil hasta los 90 días. * Etiquetado y trazabilidad: Se registra cada lote. Cada sobre recibe una etiqueta con el tipo de ibérico (bellote, cebo, etc.), porcentaje racial, ingredientes, peso, lote, y fecha de caducidad, asegurando el cumplimientod e la normativa. Desinfección continua: Los cuchillos y herramientas se desinfectan de manera constante, pasando incluso por armarios de ozono para garantizar la esterilidad Perfil del candidato: * No se requiere formación previa, pero será valorable haber tenido experiencia en sala de loncheo. Condiciones laborales: * Contrato indefinido con periodo de prueba, a jornada completa. * Horario: De mañana y tarde * Salario: Según convenio. Observaciones: OFERTA ACOGIDA AL DECRETO 29/2024. Er du gået i stå i din karriere i Danmark, måske er det tid til at du tager på det senere sabbatår i udlandet?

Vi hjælper danskere med at tage til udlandet for at finde ro, livskvalitet og en anderledes hverdag.

En af vores kandidater på 64 år, med 30 års ledererfaring havde altid drømt om at arbejde i Grækenland. Han troede, det var for sent – men fra i år sidder han i kundeservice med udsigt til Middelhavet og lever sin drøm. Hans historie viser, at det aldrig er for sent at tage springet, og at erfaring og livserfaring er en styrke, som virksomheder i Sydeuropa værdsætter højt.

Hvorfor vælge udlandet som din nye start?
Du får mulighed for at opleve en ny kultur, et mildere klima og en anderledes livsstil. Du kan bruge dine eksisterende kompetencer i kundeservice, rejsebranchen eller hospitality – eller prøve noget helt nyt. Mange virksomheder tilbyder oplæring, betalt ferie og interne udviklingsprogrammer, så du kan vokse i jobbet.

Du skal have en mindre opsparing med, da du ofte først får fuld løn efter en måned. Der kan være udgifter til depositum og husleje, som skal betales ved ankomst. Vi hjælper dig med at afklare kontraktforhold, boligmuligheder, sundhedsforsikring og opsigelsesvilkår. Det er vigtigt at tale med en professionel karrierecoach, så du får den rette sparring og undgår dyre fejl.

Derfor er vi med dig hele vejen:
Vi afdækker dine kompetencer og ønsker. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til din profil. Vi forbereder dig til interviewet og sikrer, at du stiller de rigtige spørgsmål. Vi støtter dig frem til din første arbejdsdag – og videre, hvis du ønsker at udvikle dig i virksomheden.

jobs.title: Outcomes Growth Strategy and Programs Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s global Outcomes organization is focused on helping customers achieve business objectives with Notion. As the Growth Strategy & Programs Lead, you will help design and scale the programs, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives that make install-base growth more explosive and repeatable globally.



This is a high-impact strategy and programs role. You will create the clarity, structure, and execution systems that help the business grow existing customers more deliberately.



You will bring analytical rigor to how we understand growth, translate insights into scalable programs, and help teams execute with consistency while still allowing for local market nuance. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a model, writing a crisp recommendation, aligning executive stakeholders, and turning a strategy into a practical field motion.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS, YOU WILL:

 - Learn Notion's post-sales operating model, regional execution model, and current install-base growth priorities.

 - Partner with RevOps, Data Science, Finance, Sales, Outcomes, and Services leaders to develop a practical view of the key drivers and leading indicators behind retention and expansion.

 - Identify a focused set of priority growth programs or plays to support the business in the near term.

 - Build the initial program plans, success metrics, stakeholder map, and operating cadence for those priority initiatives.

 - Partner with regional teams to understand how global programs should be adapted for local execution.

 - Create clear documentation, field-facing materials, and executive-ready updates that help teams align and act.

 - Establish a repeatable rhythm for reviewing progress, capturing learnings, and improving




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Help build a clear, shared view of the drivers behind expansion and adoption across Notion's customer base.

 - Design and scale global programs that support customer adoption, value realization, cross-sell, upsell, and durable growth.

 - Partner with regional and functional leaders to turn local learnings into repeatable playbooks, programs, and operating cadences.

 - Create measurement, reporting, and review mechanisms that help teams understand what is working and where to focus.

 - Support the design of customer growth motions that connect Sales, Services, and Partners.

 - Help codify best practices so growth becomes part of the standard operating rhythm, not a set of one-off campaigns.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive them from idea to operational execution.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience in management consulting, investment banking, business operations, or post-sales GTM operations.

 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; you can turn ambiguous business questions into clear frameworks, insights, and recommendations.

 - Proven ability to design and manage cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.

 - Strong stakeholder management across senior leaders and operating teams, with the ability to align people around a shared plan.

 - Excellent written communication, including crisp strategy docs, program plans, executive updates, and field-facing materials.

 - Comfort working in a global organization where programs need a strong central strategy and room for regional adaptation.

 - Ability to operate autonomously, prioritize effectively, and bring structure to fast-moving, ambiguous work.

 - Strong business judgment and curiosity about what drives customer adoption, retention, and expansion.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with usage-based, consumption-based, or product-led growth models.

 - Experience building or scaling global programs across multiple regions or customer segments.

 - Exposure to pricing, packaging, services, partners, or monetization initiatives.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $250,000 - $280,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74. 



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Kas tunned, et soovid teha tööd, millel on päriselt tähendus? Kas lastega suhtlemine toob sulle rõõmu ning soovid olla kellelegi toeks tema igapäevases kasvamises ja arengus?
Meie meeskond ootab endaga liituma tugiisikuid, kes soovivad panustada laste heaolusse, turvatundesse ja enesekindluse kasvamisse. Sinu roll tugiisikuna: olla lapsele igapäevane toetaja ja julgustaja; aidata kaasa lapse arengule ja iseseisvuse kujunemisele; luua turvaline ja hooliv keskkond; teha koostööd pere ja spetsialistidega.

Omalt poolt pakume: Püsivat tööd;
Toetavat meeskonda ja sisekoolitusi; Tähendusrikast ja südantsoojendavat tööd; Toetavat meeskonda ja juhendamist; Võimalust päriselt midagi muuta ühe lapse elus.

Muud nõuded: Otsime tugiisikuid, kes sobivad hästi lastega, on kohusetundlikud ja peavad kinni kokkulepetest ning on soovitavalt läbinud tugiisiku koolituse või valmis seda läbima.
Ootame sind, kui: hoolid lastest ja soovid nendega töötada; oled kannatlik, empaatiline ja usaldusväärne; suudad märgata lapse vajadusi ja pakkuda tuge; oled valmis õppima ja arenema. See ei ole lihtsalt töö – see on võimalus olla kellelegi oluline tugi ja turvatunne.

jobs.title: Søges: To medarbejdere til vores rengøringsteam, Middelfart, Denmark
jobs.description:
Rengøringsmedarbejder hos Noordwind Galsklint Strand Camping.

Er du vild med camping, naturen og at omgås mennesker? Har du sans for struktur og kan du godt lide at give en hånd med? Vi søger to personer, der sammen som et fast team står for rengøringen og deler arbejdet ligeligt mellem sig – så er du måske lige den rette til at styrke os.

Dine opgaver:

  • Rengøring af sanitetsområder, køkkener, receptionen og butikken
  • Rengøring af hytterne, når gæsterne er tjekket ud
  • Påfyldning af forbrugsartikler
  • Overvågning af forbruget og indberetning ved mangler
  • Indberetning af defekter eller ønsker om ændringer i arbejdsgange, materialer osv.
  • Støtte til pladslederen
  • Mulighed for flere arbejdstimer:
  • Hvis du ønsker det, kan du påtage dig yderligere opgaver – i så fald øger vi det ugentlige timetal eller din løn tilsvarende.


Vi forventer, at du:

  • taler dansk eller engelsk
  • er venlig, selvstændig og serviceorienteret
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for rengøringsbranchen.


Det tilbyder vi:

  • En fast plads i et team på to, der deler arbejdet ligeligt – I skiftes til vagterne og holder altid fri på skift
  • Fast gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid med timekonto: i gennemsnit ca. 10 timer om ugen pr. person – mest i højsæsonen (juli–august, op til ca. 20 timer/uge), mindre om vinteren (ca. 3 timer/uge), når I tager ferie og udnytter kompensationsfrihed. Efter aftale kan I øge jeres timetal ved at påtage jer yderligere opgaver.
  • Helårsstilling – pladsen har åbent hele året (om vinteren i mindre omfang)
  • Nyd naturen, når vagten er slut, her på vores campingplads
  • Arbejdstider: i højsæsonen alle ugens dage og ellers efter aftale
  • Et imødekommende team og en arbejdsplads midt i naturen.


Blev du nysgerrig?
Kontakt os for spørgsmål eller send din ansøgning med det samme:
simon.kilimann@noordwind.eu
+49 4120 347 9993 – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
Stillingen skal besættes med det samme.

Hos “Noordwind” elsker vi naturen og de oplevelser, den giver – uanset om det er i eksklusive ferielejligheder eller i et telt på en campingplads. Vi står for moderne, naturnære og afslappede ferieoplevelser, som vi hele tiden udvikler og fornyer.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Analyse existing business processes, workflows, systems, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement across business and operational functions. Document, structure, and prioritise business requirements to support the development and implementation of practical, technology-driven solutions. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness, and overall business performance. Identify opportunities for automation and AI integration across daily, weekly, and monthly reporting and operational processes. Develop and support automated reporting solutions using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting or data visualisation tools. Explore and support the introduction of AI-based tools and automation technologies to reduce manual workload in areas including reporting, data entry, scheduling, forecasting, and operational analysis. Work with internal teams and external IT providers to support the design, development, and implementation of business systems and digital solutions. Support system integration activities to ensure new tools and platforms operate effectively with existing business systems, processes, and workflows. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly communicated, understood, and appropriately delivered. Assist with solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support for new systems and business process changes. Develop and enhance management reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to support effective, data-driven decision-making. Support the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across reporting and operational systems. Promote appropriate data governance practices, including compliance with GDPR and internal data security requirements. Translate technical concepts into clear business language and communicate business requirements effectively to technical stakeholders. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

jobs.title: Social Media & Marketing Executive
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Manage daily posting and scheduling across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok to maintain a consistent and recognisable brand presence. Create engaging content, including photos, reels, carousels, and stories, for new menu items, seasonal campaigns, and in-store promotions. Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar that aligns posts with menu changes, promotions, and key seasonal dates such as Black Friday, Christmas, Valentine's Day, and St. Patrick's Day. Plan and run paid social campaigns through Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads to drive footfall, online orders, and conversions. Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and online reviews promptly to build positive customer relationships and protect the cafe's reputation. Design digital marketing materials such as promotional banners, email headers, menu graphics, and social creatives using Canva or Adobe tools. Send weekly email newsletters featuring offers, new arrivals, loyalty rewards, and upcoming events using tools like Mailchimp or HubSpot. Manage and grow the customer loyalty programme, promoting sign-ups across social and in-store channels. Build relationships with local influencers, food bloggers, and media to coordinate PR drops, collaborations, product seeding, and secure features and reviews. Analyse social and email performance using platform insights and Google Analytics, and produce monthly reports with key metrics and recommendations. Keep the cafe's Google Business Profile up to date, including photos, opening hours, and seasonal updates, to support local search visibility. Help plan and promote in-store events, tastings, and community activities to drive engagement and footfall. Work with store teams to capture in-store photos, videos, customer testimonials, and user-generated content. About You Strong understanding of Irish retail and consumer trends. Proficiency in content creation tools like Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or Premiere Pro. Experience running paid social campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads). Familiarity with email marketing tools (Mailchimp/ HubSpot). Knowledge of Google Analytics and social platform insights for performance tracking. Excellent copywriting skills with attention to brand tone. Ability to multitask and manage multiple campaigns simultaneously. Experience working with influencers and brand ambassadors. Strong communication and organisational skills. Flexibility to support weekend or in-store events when required. The company reserves the right to amend these duties from time to time and as determined by business needs. Working Hours: 39 Hours Per week Annual Salary: 36,605.00 Company Name: Adleo Limited t/a O'Briens Sandwich Cafe Job Location: Fairyhill, Newtownpark Avenue, Blackrock, Dublin, Ireland, A94 P993 Start date: 24/08/2026

jobs.title: Specialist Psychiatrist – Northern Norway
jobs.description:
Specialist Psychiatrist – Northern Norway

 

We are looking for a specialist psychiatrist for a permanent position in Northern Norway.

You will join a well-functioning outpatient clinic and work closely with an experienced team. The region is known for its relaxed pace of life, strong professional environments, and supportive colleagues.

Your role
  • Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with psychiatric conditions
  • Contribute actively to interdisciplinary collaboration and treatment planning
  • Supervise junior doctors and support internal training
  • Take part in developing the service and improving clinical practice
Qualifications
  • European medical authorization and specialist certification in psychiatry
  • Good English skills and motivation to learn Norwegian (language training provided)
  • Solid clinical competence and ability to work independently
What the clinic offers
  • Permanent position in a stable and well-organized outpatient unit
  • Close collaboration with experienced and supportive colleagues
  • Flexible working hours, with options for extended shifts and additional pay
  • Access to courses, seminars, and continuous professional development
  • Optional participation in acute care rotation, with extra compensation
  • Pension and insurance schemes through KLP
Why Northern Norway?

Northern Norway offers a unique combination of professional opportunities and quality of life.

You get access to modern healthcare facilities while living close to nature. The region is known for its dramatic landscapes, with mountains, fjords, and coastline right outside your door.

It is a great place for both individuals and families. You will find good schools, safe communities, and a slower, more balanced lifestyle.

Outdoor activities are part of everyday life — whether it is hiking, skiing, fishing, or simply enjoying the Northern Lights in winter and the midnight sun in summer.

Despite the remote location, you have access to regional airports and solid connections to the rest of Norway and Europe.

Benefits with Dignus Medical
  • Free Norwegian language course tailored for healthcare professionals
  • Personal follow-up throughout the entire recruitment process
  • Relocation support for you and your family (housing, schools, kindergartens)

  • Guidance with authorization, paperwork, and practical matters

     

Interested?

 

Take the first step towards a new career and lifestyle in Norway. Contact us for a confidential and informal chat!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Psychiatrist wanted for position in adult psychiatry in Southern Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of a well-established outpatient clinic in Southern Norway, we are recruiting a specialist psychiatrist for a permanent role in adult psychiatry.

You will become part of a competent interdisciplinary team in a region known for its mild climate and friendly communities.

 

Your role

  • Assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of adult patients with psychiatric conditions
  • Active participation in interdisciplinary collaboration and treatment planning
  • Supervision of junior doctors and contribution to internal training
  • Engagement in the clinic’s development and professional improvements

Qualifications

  • European medical authorization and specialist certification in psychiatry
  • Fluent in English and motivated to learn Norwegian (language training will be provided)
  • Broad competence in adult psychiatry and ability to work independently

The clinic offers

  • A permanent position in a stable and well-functioning outpatient unit
  • An interdisciplinary team with skilled and supportive colleagues
  • Flexible working hours and opportunities for extended shifts with extra pay
  • Access to professional courses, seminars, and specialist development days
  • Possibility to take part in acute care rotation (optional, extra pay)
  • Secure pension and insurance schemes via KLP

Why Southern Norway?

 

Southern Norway (Sørlandet) combines modern healthcare infrastructure with a high quality of life. The region is family-friendly, with good schools, kindergartens and accessible housing.

With a milder climate than most other parts of Norway, Sørlandet is especially known as a popular holiday destination during summer, attracting both Norwegians and international visitors to its charming towns and cultural scene. At the same time, the region offers a relaxed pace of life year-round, with plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and cultural events.

 

International airports and proximity to Oslo, make it easy to stay connected with the rest of Europe. You can read more about the area at Visit Southern Norway.

jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få lakken til at skinne igen! 

Er du den, der får et tilfredsstillende sug i maven, når en bil forlader kabinen med en spejlblank finish? Elsker du duften af frisk lak og præcision i hver eneste sprøjtning? Så er det dig, vi leder efter!

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

Hvad skal du lave?

Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Ansvarsområde er kabinen og du skal være med til at sikre den daglig drift i kabinen.
  • Sikre jævnt flow, korrekt farvematch og en finish, der spiller.
  • Selvom du har et medansvar for kabinen, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det.
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens.

Hvem er du?

Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har erfaring med sprøjtelakering – enten som udlært autolakerer eller med solid erfaring.
  • Går op i kvalitet og finish – du lakerer ikke bare, du skaber mesterværker.
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver
  • Har B-kørekort – så bilerne ikke kun ser flotte ud, men også kan flyttes.
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens.

Hvad får du?

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi ved, hvad dygtige folk er værd!
  • Gode kollegaer, der deler din passion for lakering og håndværk.
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med
  • Mulighed for udvikling
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med humor og højt til loftet.
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener.

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige lakmester med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette.

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme. 

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: MARKETING EXECUTIVE
Senior Technical Program Manager, Security
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own our vulnerability management program end to end. In this role, you will drive vulnerability intake, triage, remediation, and reporting across our bug bounty program, our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, source code hosted on GitHub, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS services. You will partner closely with platform engineering, product engineering, SRE, security, IT, legal, and vendor management to make sure vulnerabilities are found fast, triaged accurately, and closed within SLA — and that leadership always has a clear, current picture of the organization's risk posture.The ideal candidate uses AI and automation aggressively to scale themselves, but understands that the core value is clarity, tradeoffs, and execution, not just tooling.



What you'll do:

 - Program Ownership: Own and continuously improve the vulnerability management program, including intake, severity scoring (CVSS/risk-based), SLA definition, and remediation tracking across all asset types.

 - Bug Bounty Operations: Manage the triage/payouts/rewards workflow, and report on program health and trends.

 - Cloud Remediation (GCP): Drive remediation of vulnerabilities found in GCP infrastructure — IAM, networking, Compute/GKE, storage, and logging/monitoring configuration — by partnering with security, cloud, and platform engineering teams.

 - Code & Supply Chain Security: Coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced through SAST/DAST/SCA tooling (Wiz Code, Snyk, Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning) across engineering repos, including dependency and supply-chain risk.

 - SaaS Vendor Risk: Build and manage the process for assessing and tracking security posture across third-party SaaS applications.

 - Escalation & Exceptions: Define and enforce escalation paths for overdue or critical/high-severity findings, including risk acceptance and exception processes with appropriate sign-off.

 - Cross-Team Accountability: Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to embed remediation work into sprint planning and hold teams accountable to remediation SLAs.

 - Reporting & Alerting: Establish and maintain a single source of truth for vulnerability status, aging, SLA compliance, and risk trends, with dashboards for engineering leadership, security leadership, and executives.

 - Audit & Compliance Support: Support audit and compliance efforts (SOC 2, ISO 27001, customer security questionnaires) by keeping vulnerability management evidence and metrics audit-ready.

 - Process & Automation: Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual triage effort and improve time-to-remediation across all vulnerability sources.



Required Skill & Experience:

 - Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in technical program management, security program management, or security operations, with direct ownership of a vulnerability management or application security program.

 - Bug Bounty Expertise: Hands-on experience running a bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti), including triage and payout workflows.

 - Cloud Security Knowledge (GCP): Working knowledge of GCP security fundamentals: IAM, VPC/networking, Security Command Center, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, and common cloud misconfiguration risks.

 - Code Security Familiarity: Familiarity with GitHub-based development workflows and code security tooling (Wiz Code, Dependabot, SAST/DAST/SCA tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or CodeQL).

 - Risk Prioritization: Strong grasp of vulnerability scoring frameworks (CVSS) and risk-based prioritization.

 - Communication: Excellent cross-functional communication skills — able to translate technical vulnerability data into business risk for executive audiences and hold engineering teams accountable without owning the code themselves.

 - Reporting Tools: Proven ability to build reporting/dashboards (e.g., Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, Tableau, Looker) that give leadership real-time visibility into program health.

 - Compliance Awareness: Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or FedRAMP.



What we value:

 - Systems Thinking: The ability to see the “big picture” and understand how vulnerability management decisions impact the entire stack — cloud, code, and vendor ecosystem alike.

 - Technical Influence: The ability to drive alignment across engineering and security through expertise and collaboration rather than direct authority.

 - Autonomy: Comfortable owning a program end to end and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Bias for Action: A track record of closing the gap between finding a vulnerability and actually getting it fixed.
   
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Architecte réseaux laser en espace libre (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job posting in English below

Rejoignez Airbus Defence & Space !

Au sein d'Airbus Defence and Space, le rôle de l'entité Connected Intelligence (CI) est de fournir à ses clients des solutions de communications sécurisées, à haut débit, multimédia (voix, données, vidéo), disponibles à tout moment et partout dans le monde.

Pour ce faire, CI est devenu un leader mondial des communications par satellites (SATCOM) civiles et militaires capable de concevoir et opérer des infrastructures en propre ou pour ses clients. Pour maintenir ce leadership, CI mène une politique ambitieuse d'innovation afin d'étoffer son portefeuille de solutions à haute valeur ajoutée.

Dans ce but, CI cherche un/une Architecte réseaux Laser en espace libre (H/F) maîtrisant les technologies de communication par Laser et la réalisation de réseaux incluant des segments Laser :
Réseau IP conventionnels;
Réseaux point à point, point à multipoint, maillés, ... ;
Porteurs fixes et mobiles;
Milieux : spatial, aérien, terrestre, maritime.


Vous avez un intérêt pour les réseaux IP et les systèmes de communication complexes, hautement sécurisés. Vous êtes capable de faire preuve de créativité et avez l'envie de vous investir sur des sujets techniques complexes et innovants. Vous serez intégré(e) à un pôle d'ingénierie chargé de concevoir et développer les systèmes de communication de défense du futur.  

Les activités actuelles de l'équipe ont pour but d'exploiter les possibilités offertes par les technologies émergentes (laser, quantique,...) dans le cadre des services de communications sécurisés, sur tout type de support (satellite, 5G,...), en utilisant des techniques de réseaux programmables (SDN).

Vous prendrez part en tant qu'Architecte aux différents projets faisant appel aux moyens de communication Laser.

Ce poste exige une connaissance des risques potentiels de non-conformité.

Le/la titulaire s'engage à agir avec intégrité, fondement du succès et de la croissance durable de la Société.

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous aurez les missions suivantes :
Assurer une veille technologique permanente au contact des équipes internes et des équipementiers ;
Supporter les avant ventes à savoir (ex : pédagogie envers les équipes internes et envers les clients; proposition de solutions techniques) ;
Maquetter des solutions ou des preuves de concept ;
Contribuer à la conception des solutions destinées aux clients (ex: spécification des segments Laser; Interface avec les autres composants systèmes) ;
Spécifier les évolutions nécessaires des composant Airbus Defence & Space pour implémenter ces solutions et identifier d'éventuels nouveaux composants à développer ;
Assurer le maintien de tous les documents techniques liés aux solutions proposées ;
Support et expertise aux équipes de conception et d'IVQ système.


Profil :

Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes :
Titulaire d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur (ou équivalent) dans le domaine des réseaux informatiques avec une spécialisation sur les systèmes optiques Laser et Optoélectronique ;
Expérience dans des environnements réseaux complexes, typés opérateurs télécom ou militaire ou WAN étendus de grands groupes ou d'OIV ;
Capacité reconnue à concevoir et réaliser des solutions techniques livrées à des clients ;
Connaissance des problématiques de transmission par laser ainsi que des réseaux IP classiques ;
Notions d'ingénierie des systèmes complexes ;
Vous êtes autonome et désireux de porter des sujets innovants ;
Vous savez travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires et avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles ;
Niveau de négociation en Français et avancé en Anglais.


====

Join Airbus Defence & Space !

Within Airbus Defence and Space CIS, the role of the Connected Intelligence (CI) business unit is to provide its customers with secure, high-speed, multimedia (voice, data, video) communications solutions available at any time and anywhere in the world.

To achieve this, CI has become a world leader in civil and military satellite communications (SATCOM), capable of designing and operating infrastructure on its own or for its customers. To maintain this leadership, CI is pursuing an ambitious policy of innovation to expand its portfolio of high value-added solutions.

To this end, CI is looking for a Free Space Laser Network Architect (M/F) who is proficient in laser communication technologies and the implementation of networks including laser segments:
Conventional IP network;
Point to point, point to multipoint, mesh networks, ... ;
Fixed and mobile carriers;
Environments: space, air, land, sea.


You have an interest in IP networks and complex, highly secure communication systems.

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. Experience & interest in vibe coding and/or technical experience is highly valued.

This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your expertise to build a world-class BDR organization that effectively cuts through the noise to communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives

 - Develop and implement BDR processes, playbooks, and best practices for cold and warm-outbound channels

 - Coach and mentor BDRs on qualification methodology, objection handling, and pipeline generation techniques

 - Partner with sales leadership to provide feedback on territory assignments, quotas, performance metrics, lead handoff processes

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ensuring your team can articulate this vision compellingly

 - Collaborate with marketing and operations to optimize lead routing, provide feedback on campaign effectiveness, and improve lead quality & conversion

 - Analyze team performance data and implement strategies to improve conversion rates and meeting quality

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard new SDR/BDR team members as the organization scales

 - Maintain accountability for team quota attainment and individual BDR development

 - Work closely with Account Executives and AE leaders to ensure smooth handoffs and tight feedback loops

 - Uphold CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy across the SDR organization

 - Stay current on industry trends and competitive landscape to inform team strategy




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years of sales development experience with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role, preferably some with a technical ICP

 - Proven track record of building and scaling BDR teams, preferably in a high-growth environment

 - Strong individual contributor background with deep understanding of both inbound & outbound prospecting, demand gen strategies, and industry best practices

 - Excellent coaching and mentoring abilities with experience developing junior sales talent

 - Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

 - Experience with CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot/SFDC, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead, Outreach, Default, etc)

 - Ability to recruit, interview, and assess SDR candidates effectively

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with marketing and sales teams

 - Passion for technology and ability to quickly learn and teach complex technical concepts

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus




NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience building inbound SDR programs from 0-1 and/or scaling from early stage

 - Basic understanding of software development or coding concepts

 - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social)

 - Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM (Salesforce coming soon)

 - ZoomInfo

 - Outreach

 - Gong

 - Chorus

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - Nooks

 - Default

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You're not based in the Salt Lake City area and/or willing to relocate

 - You have no interest in understanding the software development lifecycle or learning basic coding concepts

 - You're not passionate about AI

 - You prefer individual contributor work over people management and team building

 - You're uncomfortable with a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may shift quickly



This is a full-time hybrid role and has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.description:
Wir suchen im Homeoffice eine/n offene/n, empathische/n und kommunikationsstarke/n
**Gesundheitsberater / Gesundheits-Coach (Quereinstieg)**

Sind Sie bereit für eine sinnstiftende berufliche Neuorientierung? Wir sind zukunftsorientiert im Bereich Healty Longevity (Langes gesundes Leben unterwegs. Hier suchen wir Sie mit Lebenserfahrung, die Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu einem gesünderen Leben begleiten möchten. Auch ohne klassische Ausbildung im medizinischen Bereich ermöglichen wir Ihnen einen erfolgreichen Quereinstieg.

**Ihre Aufgaben: Was Sie erwartet**

Kunden/Interessenten Gewinnung Betreuung und Beratung
•     Sie führen Beratungsgespräche mit unseren Interessierten Kundinnen und Kunden (persönlich oder online).
•    Lösungsfindung: Sie unterstützen unsere Klienten dabei, gesundheitliche Ziele zu definieren und im Alltag umzusetzen (z.B. in den Bereichen Ernährung, Bewegung und Stressmanagement).
•    Begleitung: Sie fungieren als kontinuierlicher Ansprechpartner/in und motivieren unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf ihrem Weg.
•    Administration: Sie erfassen die Beratungsgespräche und verwalten diese.
Ihr Profil: Was Sie mitbringen
•    Berufserfahrung: Sie haben bereits Berufserfahrung in einem anderen Tätigkeitsfeld gesammelt (z.B. aus Kundendienst, HR, Vertrieb, Pädagogik, Gastronomie oder Fitness).
•    Lebenskompetenz: Sie verfügen über eine hohe soziale Kompetenz, Empathie und ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Gesundheitsthemen.
•    Kommunikationstalent: Sie sind ein starker Kommunikator, der gut zuhören kann und komplexe Dinge verständlich erklärt.
•    Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute mündliche Kenntnisse Schweizerdeutsch(weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus).
•    Lernbereitschaft: Sie haben Freude daran, sich neues Fachwissen im Bereich Gesundheit und Prävention anzueignen.

**Unser Angebot: Was wir Ihnen bieten**
•    Strukturierter Quereinstieg: Ein umfassendes Einarbeitungsprogramm inkl. Mentoring.
•    Aus- und Weiterbildung: Interne berufsbegleitende zum zertifizierten Healthy Longevity Coach HLV Akad,).
•    Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Ein Job, bei dem die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden von Menschen im Mittelpunkt stehen.
•    Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Homeoffice
•    Faire Entlöhnung: Ein attraktives Gehaltspacket sowie gute Sozialleistungen.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben mit Fokus auf Ihre Motivation für den Quereinstieg) an die hinterlegte Mail-Adresse

jobs.title: TRANSPORTA MEHĀNIĶIS
jobs.employer: Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību "Orange Truck S
jobs.description:
Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību "Orange Truck Service"  aicina darbā Transporta mehāniķi

Transporta mehāniķa galvenie darba pienākumi ietver automobīļu un citu transportlīdzekļu tehnisko apkopi, diagnostiku, remontu un mehānisko mezglu regulēšanu. Transporta mehāniķim jānodrošina transportlīdzekļu nepārtraukta un droša darbība, jākonstatē un jānovērš bojājumus, jāplāno remontdarbus, lai izvairītos no dīkstāvēm, un jāievēro darba drošības noteikumus.


Galvenie darba pienākumi: Diagnostika un pārbaude: Transportlīdzekļu tehniskā stāvokļa novērtēšana un bojājumu konstatēšana, izmantojot diagnostikas iekārtas, mērinstrumentus un datorprogrammas. Detaļu nomaiņas nepieciešamības diagnosticēšana un nepieciešamo detaļu pasūtīšana.

Profesijai specifiskie pamatuzdevumi

— dzinēju un mezglu apkalpošana: Dzinēju, tai skaitā iekšdedzes dzinēju un dīzeļdzinēju, remonts un regulēšana. Mehānisko mezglu montēšana, remonts un regulēšana.

Tehniskā apkope: Regulāra transportlīdzekļu tehniskā apkope un tehniskā stāvokļa pārbaude — eļļas maiņa, filtru nomaiņa, mezglu eļļošana un citu apkopes darbu veikšana saskaņā ar ražotāja norādījumiem.

jobs.title: Electronics Production Technician
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

Option to work from home: No
